   ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyTaxFullBelligerents = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearTaxFullBelligerents = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyTrialsMixed = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TRIALS_MIXED_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearCorpTax = function() {\n    var t = Number(Q.cable_neg_corp_tax) || 0\n    if (t === 1) { Q.cableNegClearTaxHalfBelligerents() }\n    else if (t === 2) { Q.cableNegClearTaxFullBelligerents() }\n    else if (t === 3) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH)\n    } else if (t === 4) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_SOYLENT)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_MAGRAIL)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_BRAZOS)\n    }\n    Q.cable_neg_corp_tax = 0\n    Q.cable_neg_corp_tax_fund = 0\n    Q.cable_neg_brazos_tax_exempt = 0\n}\nQ.cableNegHasPoliceTransfer = function() {\n    return Q.cable_neg_police_vats === 1 || Q.cable_neg_police_railyard === 1\n        || Q.cable_neg_police_docks === 1 || Q.cable_neg_police_limelight === 1\n}\nQ.cableNegEffectivePolicePay = function() {\n    var pay = Number(Q.cable_neg_police_pay) || 0\n    if (pay > 0) { return pay }\n    return Q.cableNegHasPoliceTransfer() ? 1 : 0\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyPolicePayReprisal = function(pay) {\n    pay = Number(pay) || 0\n    if (pay === 1) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAddEach(Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 2) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAddEach(Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 3) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAddEach(Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 4) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_MAGRAIL)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_BRAZOS)\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegClearPolicePayReprisal = function(pay) {\n    pay = Number(pay) || 0\n    if (pay === 1) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 2) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 3) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 4) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_MAGRAIL)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_BRAZOS)\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegSyncPolicePayReprisal = function() {\n    var effective = Q.cableNegEffectivePolicePay()\n    var applied = Number(Q.cable_neg_police_pay_applied) || 0\n    Q.cable_neg_police_pay_effective = effective\n    if (effective === applied) { return }\n    if (applied > 0) { Q.cableNegClearPolicePayReprisal(applied) }\n    if (effective > 0) { Q.cableNegApplyPolicePayReprisal(effective) }\n    Q.cable_neg_police_pay_applied = effective\n}\nQ.cableNegClearPolicePay = function() {\n    Q.cable_neg_police_pay = 0\n    if ((Number(Q.cable_neg_corp_tax) || 0) > 0) { Q.cableNegClearCorpTax() }\n ## [2026-06-06T23:12:45Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

Done. If you demand police jurisdiction transfers but never pick a payscale, the deal now assumes **city wage (2× poverty)**.

**How it works**
- `cableNegEffectivePolicePay()` returns explicit `cable_neg_police_pay` if set, otherwise **1** when any jurisdiction transfer is on the table.
- `cableNegSyncPolicePayReprisal()` runs on `@terms_menu` and `@finalize_deal`, applying the matching reprisal (2× by default) without blocking higher pay choices.
- Explicit payscale choices still set `cable_neg_police_pay` to 2/3/4 and upgrade reprisal via the same sync.
- Security tax options now key off `cable_neg_police_pay_effective > 0`, so tax is available even with only the implicit default.
- Checklist shows a “default” line when implicit, or the specific tier when explicitly chosen.
- On a successful deal, `Q.corp_police_pay_level` is set from the effective payscale.

Withdrawing an explicit payroll demand downgrades back to the 2× default (while transfers remain). To drop payroll reprisal entirely, withdraw the jurisdiction transfers.

I'll add a lightweight progress bar without external dependencies.

A `--no-progress` flag will handle CI and verbose modes. The bar will display iteration count and current best loss, clearing on completion. A `renderProgressBar` helper will manage TTY updates.

The progress bar will complete even if the optimizer exits early due to a small step scale. It checks `process.stderr.isTTY` to decide between TTY carriage-return updates and plain text output.

The progress line shows the bar, percentage, iteration count, best loss, and step scale. On TTY terminals it overwrites the same line with a carriage return. Otherwise it prints a full line every 5% of iterations, plus the first and last steps. A `clearProgress` helper erases the bar by writing spaces and another carriage return.

The progress bar will be disabled automatically when verbose logging is active, preventing the bar from being overwritten by improvement lines.

},\n]\n\nconst STRATA = [\n    'rich', 'first', 'second', 'coop', 'drone', 'alien', 'deeper', 'third_wave',\n]\n\nfunction parseArgs(argv) {\n    const opts = {\n        months: 6,\n        iterations: 200,\n        residualMult: 10,\n        linkWeight: 1,\n        verbose: false,\n        progress: true,\n        showDecays: false,\n        jsonOut: null,\n        help: false,\n }\n        else if (a === '--show-decays') { opts.showDecays = true }\n        else if (a === '--months') { opts.months = Math.max(1, parseInt(argv[++i], 10) || 6) }\n        else if (a === !next.startsWith('--'))\n                ? path.resolve(next)\n                : path.join(ROOT, 'out', 'prosperity-optim-result.json')\n            if (opts.jsonOut === path.resolve(next)) { i++ }\n        }\n    }\n    if (opts.verbose) { opts.progress = false }\n    return opts\n}\n\nfunction buildLinkParamSpec() {\n    const spec = []\n    for (let fi = 0; fi < STRATA.length; fi++) {\n        const from = STRATA[fi]\n        const row = DEFAULT_INTRA_MESH[from] || {}\n        for (let ti = 0; ti < STRATA.length; ti++) {\n            const to = STRATA[ti]\n            if (from === to) { continue }\n            const base = Number(row[to]) || 0\n            if (base === 0) { continue }\n            spec.push({\n                kind: 'intra',\n                from,\n  const base = Number(strata[sid]) || 0\n            if (base === 0) { continue }\n            spec.push({\n                kind: 'ig_home',\n                ig: link.ig,\n                district: buildLinkParamSpec()\n\nfunction deepCloneMesh(mesh) {\n    const out = {}\n    for (const from in mesh) {\n        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(mesh, from)) { continue }\n        out[from] = Object.assign({}, mesh[from])\n    }\n    return out\n}\n\nfunction deepCloneIgLinks(links) {\n    return links.map(function(link) {\n        return {\n            ig: link.ig,\n            district: link.district,\n            toStrata: Object.assign({}, link.toStrata),\n        }\n    })\n}\n\nfunction baselineVector() {\n    const vec = DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES.map(function(b) { return b.count })\n    for (let i = 0; i < LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length; i++) {\n        vec.push(LINK_PARAM_SPEC[i].base)\n    }\n    return vec\n}\n\nfunction vectorToPlan(vec, opts) {\n    const assetCounts = []\n    for (let i = 0; i < DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES.length; i++) {\n        const n = Math.round(vec[i])\n        assetCounts.push(Math.max(opts.minAsset, Math.min(opts.maxAsset, n)))\n    }\n    const linkCoeffs = []\n    for (let j = 0; j < LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length; j++) {\n        const v = vec[DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES.length + j]\n        linkCoeffs.push(Math.max(opts.minLink, Math.min(opts.maxLink, v)))\n    }\n    return { assetCounts, linkCoeffs }\n}\n\nfunction applyMeshFromCoeffs(baseMesh, linkCoeffs) {\n    const mesh = deepCloneMesh(baseMesh)\n    for (let i = 0; i < LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length; i++) {\n        const spec = LINK_PARAM_SPEC[i]\n        if (spec.kind !== 'intra') { continue }\n        if (!mesh[spec.from]) { mesh[spec.from] = {} }\n        mesh[spec.from][spec.to] = linkCoeffs[i]\n    }\n    return mesh\n}\n\nfunction applyIgLinksFromCoeffs(baseLinks, linkCoeffs) {\n    const links = deepCloneIgLinks(baseLinks)\n    for (let i = 0; i < LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length; i++) {\n        const spec = LINK_PARAM_SPEC[i]\n        if (spec.kind !== 'ig_home') { continue }\n        for (let li = 0; li < links.length; li++) {\n            if (links[li].ig !== spec.ig) { continue }\n            links[li].toStrata[spec.stratum] = linkCoeffs[i]\n            break\n        }\n    }\n    return links\n}\n\nfunction initBaseQ() {\n    const Q = loadGameRuntimes({\n        refreshProjections: true,\n        commitSeats: true,\n    })\n    Q.month = Q.month ?? 1\n    Q.year = Q.year ?? 2300\n    Q.phase = Q.phase ?? 1\n    Q.crime_level = Q.crime_level ?? 1.1\n    Q.trade_level = Q.trade_level ?? 1.12\n\n    loadSceneOnArrival(ORGANIZE_TICK, { Q })\n    loadSceneOnArrival(ECONOMIC_RUNTIME, { Q })\n    return Q\n}\n\nfunction stripStarterAssets(Q) {\n    Q.economicAssets = (Q.economicAssets || []).filter(function(entry) {\n        return !String(entry.id || '').startsWith('starter_asset_')\n    })\n    Q.economicAssetsStarterSeeded = 0\n}\n\nfunction seedStarterAssets(Q, assetCounts) {\n    stripStarterAssets(Q)\n    if (typeof Q.addAsset !== 'function') {\n        throw new Error('optimize-prosperity-balance: Q.addAsset missing — load economic_assets_runtime')\n    }\n    for (let bi = 0; bi < DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES.length; bi++) {\n        const batch = DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES[bi]\n        const count = assetCounts[bi]\n        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n            const id = 'starter_asset_' + batch.owner + '_' + batch.district + '_' + i\n            let name = batch.owner + ' site ' + (i + 1)\n            if (typeof Q.pickOwnerDisplayName === 'function') {\n                name = Q.pickOwnerDisplayName({\n                    ownerType: batch.ownerType,\n                    owner: batch.owner,\n                    district: batch.district,\n                    id: id,\n                })\n            }\n            Q.addAsset({\n                id: id,\n                name: name,\n                district: batch.district,\n                ownerType: batch.ownerType,\n                owner: batch.owner,\n            })\n        }\n    }\n    Q.economicAssetsStarterSeeded = 1\n}\n\nfunction captureBlockProsperity(Q) {\n    const state = Q.electionV2\n    const map = new Map()\n    if (!state || !state.blocks) { return map }\n    for (let i = 0; i < state.blocks.length; i++) {\n        const b = state.blocks[i]\n        if (b.population <= 0) { continue }\n        map.set(b.id, b.prosperity ?? 6)\n    }\n    return map\n}\n\nfunction runProsperityMonth(Q) {\n    if (typeof Q.applyStratumProsperityBumps === 'function') {\n        Q.applyStratumProsperityBumps()\n    }\n    if (typeof Q.applyProsperityConnections()\n    }\n    if (typeof Q.processMonthlyHousing === 'function') {\n        Q.processMonthlyHousing()\n    }\n}\n\nfunction prepareQ(plan) {\n    const Q = initBaseQ()\n    if (typeof Q.initEconomicAssets === 'function') {\n        Q.initEconomicAssets()\n    }\n    seedStarterAssets(Q, plan.assetCounts)\n\n    Q.prosperityIntraDistrictMeshDefault = plan.linkCoeffs,\n    )\n\n    if (typeof Q.applyEconomicAssetProsperity === 'function') {\n        Q.applyEconomicAssetProsperity()\n    }\n    if (typeof Q.qified_block_prosperity === 'function') {\n        Q.qified_block_prosperity()\n    }\n    return Q\n}\n\nfunction computeLoss(Q, initialProsperity, plan, opts) {\n    const state = Q.electionV2\n    let popSum = 0\n    let weightedSq = 0\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < state.blocks.length; i++) {\n        const block = state.blocks[i]\n        if (block.population <= 0) { continue }\n        const init = initialProsperity.get(block.id)\n        if (init == null) { continue }\n        const final = block.prosperity ?? 6\n        const err = final - init\n        weightedSq += block.population * err * err\n        popSum += block.population\n    }\n\n    const residualLoss = opts.residualMult * (popSum > 0 ? weightedSq / popSum : 0)\n\n    let linkPenalty = 0\n    for (let c = 0; c < plan.linkCoeffs.length; c++) {\n        linkPenalty += Math.abs(plan.linkCoeffs[c])\n    }\n\n    return {\n        total: residualLoss + opts.linkWeight * linkPenalty,\n        residualLoss,\n        linkPenalty,\n        popSum,\n    }\n}\n\nfunction evaluateVector(vec, opts) {\n    const plan = vectorToPlan(vec, opts)\n    const Q = prepareQ(plan)\n    const initial = captureBlockProsperity(Q)\n\n    for (let m = 0; m < opts.months; m++) {\n        runProsperityMonth(Q)\n    }\n\n    const loss = computeLoss(Q, initial, plan, opts)\n    return { loss, plan, initial, Q }\n}\n\nfunction stepSizeForIndex(index, opts) {\n    return index < DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES.length ? opts.assetStep : opts.linkStep\n}\n\nfunction optimize(opts) {\n    let vec = baselineVector()\n    let best = evaluateVector(vec, opts)\n    let stepScale = 1\n\n    if (opts.verbose) {\n        console.log('Baseline loss:', best.loss.total.toFixed(6),\n            `(residual=${best.loss.residualLoss.toFixed(6)}, link=${best.loss.linkPenalty.toFixed(6)})`)\n    }\n\n    for (let iter = 0; iter < opts.iterations; iter++) {\n        let improved = false\n        const order = vec.map(function(_, i) { return i })\n        shuffleInPlace(order)\n\n        for (let oi = 0; oi < order.length; oi++) {\n            const i = order[oi]\n            const step = stepSizeForIndex(i, opts) * stepScale\n            for (const dir of [-1, 1]) {\n                const trial = vec.slice()\n                trial[i] += dir * step\n                const result = evaluateVector(trial, opts)\n                if (result.loss.total < best.loss.total) {\n                    best = result\n                    vec = trial\n                    improved = true\n                    if (opts.verbose) {\n                        console.log(\n                            `iter ${iter + 1} idx ${i} -> loss ${best.loss.total.toFixed(6)}`,\n                        )\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!improved) {\n            stepScale *= 0.5\n            if (stepScale < 1e-6) { break }\n        }\n\n        renderProgress(iter, opts.iterations, {\n            bestLoss: best.loss.total,\n            stepScale,\n        }, opts)\n    }\n\n    clearProgress(opts)\n\n    return { vec, best, stepScale }\n}\n\nfunction shuffleInPlace(arr) {\n    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {\n        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1))\n        const tmp = arr[i]\n        arr[i] = arr[j]\n        arr[j] = tmp\n    }\n}\n\nfunction formatPlanReport(plan, loss) {\n    const assets = DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES.map(function(batch, i) {\n        return {\n            key: batch.key,\n            owner: batch.owner,\n            district: batch.district,\n            baseline: batch.count,\n            optimized: plan.assetCounts[i],\n        }\n    })\n\n    const links = LINK_PARAM_SPEC.map(function(spec, i) {\n        return {\n            key: spec.key,\n            baseline: spec.base,\n            optimized: roundLink(plan.linkCoeffs[i]),\n        }\n    })\n\n    return {\n        loss: {\n            total: loss.total,\n            residualLoss: loss.residualLoss,\n            linkPenalty: loss.linkPenalty,\n        },\n        assets,\n        linksChanged: links.filter(function(row) {\n            return Math.abs(row.optimized - row.baseline) > 1e-9\n        }),\n        links,\n    }\n}\n\nfunction roundLink(v) {\n    return Math.round(v * 1e6) / 1e6\n}\n\nfunction printDecayTable() {\n    const baseline = 6\n    const monthly Δ ≈ coefficient × prosperity')\n    console.log('')\n    console.log(\n        pad('ID', 18)\n        + pad('Scope', 10)\n        + pad('Target', 12)\n        + pad('Coeff', 10)\n        + pad('Δ @6', 10)\n        + pad('Δ @10', 10),\n    )\n    console.log('-'.repeat(70))\n    for (let i = 0; i < AFFLUENCE_DECAY_ROWS.length; i++) {\n        const row = AFFLUENCE_DECAY_ROWS[i]\n        const d6 = row.coefficient * baseline\n        const d10 = row.coefficient * example\n        console.log(\n            pad(row.id, 18)\n            + pad(row.scope, 10)\n            + pad(row.target, 12)\n            + pad(String(row.coefficient), 10)\n            + pad(d6.toFixed(3), 10)\n            + pad(d10.toFixed(3), 10),\n        )\n    }\n    console.log('')\n    console.log('Notes:')\n    console.log('  • Stratum rows bleed each stratum block from its own prosperity (all districts).')\n    console.log('  • IG rows bleed Q.prosperity_* for corps/syndicates (Soylent/Magrail/Brazos decay faster).')\n    console.log('  • These decays are NOT tuned by optimize-prosperity-balance.js (fixed catalog).')\n    console.log('  • Intra-district mesh + IG→home-district links + starter asset counts ARE tuned.')\n    console.log('')\n}\n\nfunction pad(s, width) {\n    const str = String(s)\n    return str.length >= width ? str : str + ' '.repeat(width - str.length)\n}\n\nfunction formatProgressBar(fraction, width) {\n    width = width || 32\n    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, fraction))\n    const filled = Math.round(clamped * width)\n    return '[' + '='.repeat(filled) + '-'.repeat(width - filled) + ']'\n}\n\nfunction renderProgress(iter, total, info, opts) {\n    if (!opts.progress) { return }\n    const done = iter + 1\n    const fraction = total > 0 ? done / total : 1\n    const pct = (fraction * 100).toFixed(1)\n    const bar = formatProgressBar(fraction)\n    const line = (\n        bar\n        + ' ' + pct + '%'\n        + '  iter ' + done + '/' + total\n        + '  best ' + info.bestLoss.toFixed(4)\n        + '  step ' + info.stepScale.toExponential(1)\n    )\n    if (process.stderr.isTTY) {\n        process.stderr.write('\\r' + line.padEnd(88))\n    } else if (done === 1 || done === total || done % Math.max(1, Math.floor(total / 20)) === 0) {\n        process.stderr.write(line + '\\n')\n    }\n}\n\nfunction clearProgress(opts) {\n    if (opts.progress && process.stderr.isTTY) {\n        process.stderr.write('\\r' + ' '.repeat(88) + '\\r')\n    }\n}\n\nfunction printUsage() {\n    console.log(`Usage: node scripts/optimize-prosperity-balance.js [options]\n\n  --show-decays       Print affluence decay table and exit\n  --months N          Simulation horizon per evaluation (default 6)\n  --iterations N      Coordinate-descent iterations (default 200)\n  --residual-mult X   Weight on population-weighted prosperity MSE (default 10)\n  --link-weight X     Weight on L1 sum of linkage coefficients (default   console.log(`Optimizing ${DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES.length} asset batches + ${LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length} linkage coeffs`)\n    console.log(`  ${opts.months}-month sim · ${opts.iterations} iterations · console.log('')\n    console.log('Best loss:', report.loss.total.toFixed(6))\n    console.log('  residual:', report.loss.residualLoss.toFixed(6))\n    console.log('  linkage: ', i = 0; i < report.assets.length; i++) {\n        const a = report.assets[i]\n        if (a.optimized !== a.baseline) {\n            console.log(`  ${a.key}: ${a.baseline} → ${a.optimized}  (${a.owner} ## [2026-06-06T23:28:00Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

No — it’s **coordinate descent** (a kind of hill-climbing), not gradient descent.

**What it does**
- Starts from the baseline vector (asset counts + linkage coeffs).
- Each iteration, shuffles parameter indices and, for each one, tries **+step** and **−step**.
- Keeps any trial that lowers the loss.
- If nothing improves that round, **halves the step size** (`stepScale`) and tries again.
- Stops when the step size gets tiny or iterations run out.

**Why that’s not gradient descent**
- Gradient descent needs **partial derivatives** of the loss w.r.t. each parameter (∂loss/∂xᵢ).
- This script never computes gradients — it only **evaluates** the loss by running the 6‑month simulation.
- Updates are discrete ± steps on one coordinate at a time, not moves along a computed gradient vector.

That fits here because the loss comes from a **black-box simulation** (prosperity tick, housing, etc.), where analytic gradients aren’t available.

A rough analogy:
- **Gradient descent:** “Which direction is downhill?” → take a step that way.
- **This script:** “If I nudge this one knob up or down, is loss better?” → keep the better nudge, repeat for each knob.

Related names for the same family: **coordinate descent**, **pattern search**, or **derivative-free local search**.

## [2026-06-06T23:29:18Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

Probably **not**, for this script — and gradient descent would be awkward to apply as-is.

**The bottleneck is simulation cost, not the search algorithm.** Each trial runs a full bootstrap plus 6 months of prosperity tick. Whether you do coordinate steps or gradient steps, you’re mostly paying for **evaluations**. One “gradient step” via finite differences needs about **N+1 runs** (N ≈ 68 parameters) just to estimate the gradient — similar order of magnitude to one full coordinate-descent pass (up to ~2×N trials, many skipped when loss doesn’t improve).

**Why gradient descent fits poorly here**

1. **Black box** — There’s no analytic ∂loss/∂x. You’d approximate it by nudging each parameter and re-simulating, which is expensive and noisy.

2. **Non-smooth landscape** — Asset counts are **rounded integers**, prosperity is **clamped**, housing and connections have thresholds. Small nudges can cause flat regions or jumps, so numerical gradients are unreliable.

3. **Mixed parameters** — 11 asset counts are discrete; 57 linkages are continuous. Coordinate descent with ±1 / ±0.00005 steps handles that naturally. Plain GD wants continuous variables everywhere.

4. **Coupling** — GD can win when many parameters need to move together and the loss is smooth. Here, a lot of the action is “add/remove a starter asset” or “bump one link slightly,” which coordinate search matches well.

**When something gradient-like might help**

- **SPSA** (2 sims per pseudo-gradient) — cheaper than full finite differences, but noisier.
- **Optimize linkages with GD, assets with integer search** — split the problem.
- **Surrogate model** — fit a cheap approximate loss, optimize that, then validate in the sim (more engineering).

**Bottom line:** For this codebase, coordinate descent is a reasonable choice. Gradient descent wouldn’t clearly be faster unless you made the loss smooth and differentiable (or added a surrogate). The win would come from **fewer evals per improvement** (better algorithm + smarter parameterization), not from swapping in GD on the raw simulator.

**Why links-only is a good idea**

**Would GD be faster than coordinate descent (links only)?**

Rough cost per “full pass” over all link params:

| Method | Sim runs (worst case) |
|--------|------------------------|
| Coordinate descent (1 iter) | up to 57 × 2 = **114** trials |
| Finite-diff gradient (1 step) | **58** (baseline + 57 bumps) |
| SPSA (1 pseudo-gradient) | **2** trials |

So one gradient step can be **cheaper per sweep** than one coordinate iteration — *if* each trial costs the same.

**Why GD still might not win in practice**
1. **Noisy gradients** — prosperity is clamped, blocks are discrete, housing adds thresholds. Finite differences on the simulator are jittery; GD can overshoot or stall without careful step sizing / line search (more evals).
2. **Line search** — a good step size often means several extra sims per gradient step.
3. **Coupling** — links do interact, so GD’s “move all dims at once” can help — but coordinate descent with enough iterations often catches that anyway on a 57‑dim problem.
4. **Implementation cost** — you’d still need baseline snapshot + link-only replay; that refactor helps any method.

**What I’d actually recommend**

1. **`--links-only`** + cached seed (biggest bang for buck).
2. Keep **coordinate descent** on links first — simple, already works, no gradient noise.
3. If that’s too slow or plateaus, try **SPSA** (2 evals per update across all links) before full finite-difference GD — better fit for noisy black-box sims.
4. Full **GD** only if you see smooth loss after link-only + caching and want coordinated multi-link updates.

**Bottom line:** Links-only is worth doing; **GD on top of that is optional**, not clearly faster unless you also cheapen evals and the loss is smooth enough that fewer coordinated steps beat many coordinate nudges. **Partly — but not reliably enough to drop trials entirely without a more careful design.**

## What the loss actually cares about

Loss uses **per-block drift** from the post-seed baseline:

\[
\text{error}_b = \text{final}_b - \text{initial}_b
\]

Some blocks are too high, some too low. One link coefficient touches **many blocks** through the mesh/IG map, so there isn’t one global “turn all links up” direction.

## What you can skip safely (easy win)

**Asymmetric coordinate steps** — don’t always do both ±:

1. Try **+step** first.
2. If it improves → keep it, **skip −**.
3. If not → try **−step**.

That often cuts evals **~25–50%** with no real theory change. Same for “try predicted direction first, only flip if it fails.”

## What you’re suggesting (harder)

**Pick the sign from the last run alone, one trial per param:**

- After a sim, you know which districts/strata are high/low vs baseline.
- In principle: if a link moves prosperity **from** overshoot **to** undershoot, **increasing** it might help.

So yes, you can build a **heuristic sign** for each link from block errors + connection topology.

**Why that’s shaky:**

1. **Many links hit the same blocks** — local sign can be wrong once others are non-zero.
2. **Squared loss** — a block can be wrong either way; fixing one block can worsen another.
3. **Link penalty** \(\sum |c|\) always prefers **smaller** coeffs — opposes “boost all helpful links.”
4. **Clamps, housing, asset prosperity** — response to a link bump isn’t linear.
5. **Coupling** — the right move is often “raise this link, lower that one,” not one-sided nudges.

So “we know the direction from error” is **directionally** plausible for links-only, but not **exactly** true without either more trials or a real sensitivity model.

## “Only full step or half step”

That’s **line search in one direction**:

- Nudge in chosen sign by `step`.
- If loss improves but you suspect overshoot → try `step/2` in same direction (or backtrack).

That can help **after** a good sign guess; it doesn’t remove the need to validate the sign sometimes.

## Practical ranking (links-only)

| Approach | Eval savings | Risk |
|----------|----------------|------|
| + then − only if + fails | ~25–50% | Low |
| One-sided FD gradient (+ bump only) | ~50% vs ± | Medium (noisy sim) |
| Heuristic sign from block errors, one trial | Up to ~50% | Higher (wrong signs) |
| Cache seed + link-only replay | Huge | Low — **best ROI** |

**Bottom line:** You can speed things up by **not blindly doing both ±** — try one sign first, or use block errors to **guess** sign for links. I wouldn’t trust guess-the-sign alone without occasional ± checks or a cached fast replay. Biggest win is still **fixed assets + re-sim only link changes**, not cleverer direction logic on full reboots.

If you want this in the script, the sensible order is: (1) `--links-only` + cached eval, (2) asymmetric ±, (3) optional heuristic sign for links. I can implement that if you’d like.

**Zero lower bound**
- For a given link, effect is monotonic in a simple sense: **higher coeff → more spill into target blocks** (sources aren’t drained in the mesh/IG code; deltas are additive).
- So each parameter only has two meaningful moves: **more spill** vs **less spill (toward 0)** — no “negative spill” regime.

That makes a block-error heuristic more plausible:

> “This link feeds strata/districts that are **below** baseline → try **increasing**; if they’re **above** → try **decreasing**.”

## Why it still isn’t “accurate”

1. **Many links, one residual** — one IG row hits several strata; they can disagree. Net sign is a weighted guess.
2. **Link penalty** — loss also wants **small** `|c|`. Error-only heuristic says “pump more here”; penalty says “shrink everything.” The true best move isn’t “fix drift” alone.
3. **6-month path** — end-state error ≠ local sensitivity; decays, housing, and assets interact over time.
4. **Same matrix, many districts** — intra-mesh errors aggregate across districts with different drift.

So: **more reliable as a first guess**, not trustworthy enough to **never** try the other direction or skip evals entirely.

## Does that make gradient descent more worthwhile?

**Somewhat yes**, mainly because the problem gets nicer:

| Factor | Links-only + ≥ 0 |
|--------|------------------|
| Parameter type | Continuous box `[0, maxLink]` — good for projected GD |
| Semantics | All spills — Jacobian-ish intuition holds better |
| Heuristic | Can pick **one-sided** bumps (+ only at 0) |
| Eval cost | With caching, ~58 one-sided FD evals per step is feasible |

GD (or **SPSA**, often better for noisy sims) is more worthwhile **after** link-only + cached evals, not just because of the heuristic.

**Practical stack I’d trust:**

1. **Links-only + cached replay** (biggest win)
2. **Zero floor** (already in place; keep it)
3. **Heuristic sign** → try one direction first; flip only if loss worsens (~25–50% fewer evals)
4. **Then** SPSA or projected GD on links if coordinate descent plateaus

**Bottom line:** Zero-bound links-only makes a **direction heuristic reasonable as a first guess**, not as a substitute for simulation. That same setup is when **gradient-style** search starts to pay off — especially with cheap link-only evals — but I’d try **asymmetric coordinate + heuristic sign** before full GD.

## [2026-06-06T23:38:34Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

Implemented. Summary of what changed:

### Defaults
- **`--links-only`** (default) — tunes 57 linkage coeffs only; assets stay at baseline counts
- Link floor **`minLink: 0`** unchanged (no negative spill coefficients)
- **`--tune-assets`** — old behavior (assets + links, full reboot each eval)

### Speed
- **Cached replay** — seeds the world once, snapshots block/IG/housing/asset state, then each trial restores + updates links + runs 6 months (no full runtime reload)

### Smarter search
- **Heuristic sign** (on by default) — uses post-sim drift on each link’s target blocks to try **increase** vs **decrease** only
- **Asymmetric steps** (on by default) — if the first direction improves loss, skip the opposite
- **`--no-heuristic`** / **`--both-directions`** to disable

### Optional SPSA
- **`--method spsa`** — links-only stochastic gradient-style updates (2 sims per iteration + accept step)

### Example commands
```bash
# Recommended default
node scripts/optimize-prosperity-balance.js --iterations 30

# SPSA experiment
node scripts/optimize-prosperity-balance.js --method spsa --iterations 100

# Old full search including assets
node scripts/optimize-prosperity-balance.js --tune-assets --iterations 50
```

3 coordinate iterations with caching finished in ~6s on this machine (vs much slower with full reboots).

## [2026-06-06T23:41:38Z] assistant_thought (afterAgentThought)

I'll write a script to export the current baseline values and apply the optimized results, or handle it manually with Node.js.

Baseline values will be saved to `out/prosperity-balance-baseline.json`. The optimizer will run for 200 iterations and output results to `out/prosperity-optim-result.json`. A small script will patch the `.dry` scene file with the new values.

The apply script will replace the PROSPERITY_INTRA_DISTRICT_DEFAULT and PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS blocks in the scene file. Default constants in the optimizer script will also be updated to match the new scene values.

The apply script will be named `scripts/apply-prosperity-optim.js` and accept the optimizer JSON path as its sole argument. It will reconstruct the `.dry` mesh by rebuilding the `LINK_PARAM_SPEC` structure from the optimized `linkCoeffs`, preserving the existing compact per-stratum line format.

{
  "file_path": "/home/airy/mikasa/scripts/export-prosperity-baseline.js",
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n/**\n * Snapshot current prosperity linkage defaults (from optimize-prosperity-balance mirrors).\n *\n *   node scripts/export-prosperity-baseline.js\n *   node scripts/export-prosperity-balance.js --out out/prosperity-balance-baseline.json\n */\n\nconst fs = require('fs')\nconst path = require('path')\nconst {\n    DEFAULT_INTRA_MESH,\n    DEFAULT_IG_HOME_LINKS,\n    DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES,\n    LINK_PARAM_SPEC,\n} = require('./optimize-prosperity-balance.js')\n\nconst ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..')\n\nfunction parseOut(argv) {\n    const idx = argv.indexOf('--out')\n    if (idx >= 0 && argv[idx + 1] && !argv[idx + 1].startsWith('--')) {\n        return path.resolve(argv[idx + 1])\n    }\n    return path.join(ROOT, 'out', 'prosperity-balance-baseline.json')\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    const outPath = parseOut(process.argv.slice(2))\n    const payload = {\n        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        note: 'Baseline before prosperity optimizer run; mirrors organize_phase_tick + asset batches.',\n        intraMesh: DEFAULT_INTRA_MESH,\n        igHomeLinks: DEFAULT_IG_HOME_LINKS,\n        assetBatches: DEFAULT_ASSET_BATCHES,\n        linkParamSpec: LINK_PARAM_SPEC,\n    }\n    const dir = path.dirname(outPath)\n    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) { fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }) }\n    fs.writeFileSync(outPath, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2) + '\\n', 'utf8')\n    console.log('Wrote', outPath)\n}\n\nif (require.main === module) {\n    main()\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { main }\n"
}

}\n    lines.push(']')\n    return lines.join('\\n')\n}\n\nfunction replaceBlock(source, startMarker, endMarker, newBlock) {\n    const start = source.indexOf(startMarker)\n    if (start < 0) {\n 'utf8')\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    const jsonPath = path.resolve(process.argv[2] || path.join(ROOT, 'out', 'prosperity-optim-result.json'))\n    if (!fs.existsSync(jsonPath)) {\n        console.error('Missing optim result:', jsonPath)\n        process.exit(1)\n    }\n    const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(jsonPath, 'utf8'))\n    const linkCoeffs = payload.report && main()\n}\n\nmodule.exports = {\n    meshFromLinkCoeffs,\n    igLinksFromLinkCoeffs,\n    applyToScene,\n}\n"

row.toStrata[sid] : 0\n            return sid + ': ' + v\n        })\n        lines.push('            ' + parts.join(', ') + ',')\n        lines.push('        },')\n        lines.push('    },')\n    }\n    lines.push(']')\n    return lines.join('\\n')\n}\n\nfunction syncOptimScriptMirrors(mesh, igLinks) {\n    let text = fs.readFileSync(OPTIM_SCRIPT, 'utf8')\n    text = replaceBlock(\n        text,\n        'const DEFAULT_INTRA_MESH = {',\n        '\\n\\n/** Mirror PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS */',\n        formatConstMesh(mesh),\n    )\n    text = replaceBlock(\n        text,\n        'const DEFAULT_IG_HOME_LINKS = [',\n        '\\n\\n/** Self-feedback decay rows',\n        formatConstIgLinks(igLinks),\n    )\n    fs.writeFileSync(OPTIM_SCRIPT, text, 'utf8')\n}\n\nfunction applyToScene(mesh, igLinks) {\n    let text = fs.readFileSync(ORGANIZE_TICK, 'utf8')\n    text = replaceBlock(\n        text,\n        'var PROSPERITY_INTRA_DISTRICT_DEFAULT = {',\n        '\\n\\n/**\\n * IG prosperity → each stratum block',\n        formatMeshBlock(mesh) + '\\n',\n    )\n    text = replaceBlock(\n        text,\n        'var PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS = [',\n        '\\n\\n/** All strata wired in Docks trade spill',\n        formatIgLinksBlock(igLinks) + '\\n',\n    )\n    fs.writeFileSync(ORGANIZE_TICK, text, 'utf8')\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    const jsonPath = path.resolve(process.argv[2] || path.join(ROOT, 'out', 'prosperity-optim-result.json'))\n    if (!fs.existsSync(jsonPath)) {\n        console.error('Missing optim result:', jsonPath)\n        process.exit(1)\n    }\n    const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(jsonPath, 'utf8'))\n    const linkCoeffs = payload.report && payload.report.links\n        ? payload.report.links.map(function(row) { return row.optimized })\n        : null\n    if (!linkCoeffs || linkCoeffs.length !== LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length) {\n        console.error('Invalid optim JSON: expected report.links with', LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length, 'entries')\n        process.exit(1)\n    }\n\n    const mesh = meshFromLinkCoeffs(linkCoeffs)\n    const igLinks = igLinksFromLinkCoeffs(linkCoeffs)\n\n    applyToScene(mesh, igLinks)\n    syncOptimScriptMirrors(mesh, igLinks)\n\n    console.log('Applied', linkCoeffs.length, 'linkage coeffs to:')\n    console.log(' ', ORGANIZE_TICK)\n    console.log(' ', OPTIM_SCRIPT)\n    console.log('Best loss from JSON:', payload.report.loss.total)\n}\n\nif (require.main === module) {\n    main()\n}\n\nmodule.exports = {\n    meshFromLinkCoeffs,\n    igLinksFromLinkCoeffs,\n    applyToScene,\n}\n"
}

  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n/**\n * Apply optimizer output to organize_phase_tick.scene.dry (and sync script mirrors).\n *\n *   node scripts/apply-prosperity-optim.js out/prosperity-optim-result.json\n */\n\nconst fs = require('fs')\nconst path = require('path')\nconst {\n    DEFAULT_INTRA_MESH,\n    DEFAULT_IG_HOME_LINKS,\n    LINK_PARAM_SPEC,\n} = require('./optimize-prosperity-balance.js')\n\nconst ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..')\nconst ORGANIZE_TICK = path.join(\n    ROOT,\n    'source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry',\n)\nconst OPTIM_SCRIPT = path.join(ROOT, 'scripts/optimize-prosperity-balance.js')\n\nconst STRATA_LIST = [\n    'rich', 'first', 'second', 'coop', 'drone', 'alien', 'deeper', 'third_wave',\n]\n\nfunction roundLink(v) {\n    return Math.round(Number(v) * 1e6) / 1e6\n}\n\nfunction meshFromLinkCoeffs(linkCoeffs) {\n    const mesh = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_INTRA_MESH))\n    for (let i = 0; i < LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length; i++) {\n        const spec = LINK_PARAM_SPEC[i]\n        if (spec.kind !== 'intra') { continue }\n        if (!mesh[spec.from]) { mesh[spec.from] = {} }\n        mesh[spec.from][spec.to] = roundLink(linkCoeffs[i])\n    }\n    return mesh\n}\n\nfunction igLinksFromLinkCoeffs(linkCoeffs) {\n    const links = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_IG_HOME_LINKS))\n    for (let i = 0; i < LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length; i++) {\n        const spec = LINK_PARAM_SPEC[i]\n        if (spec.kind !== 'ig_home') { continue }\n        for (let li = 0; li < links.length; li++) {\n            if (links[li].ig !== spec.ig) { continue }\n            links[li].toStrata[spec.stratum] = roundLink(linkCoeffs[i])\n            break\n        }\n    }\n    return links\n}\n\nfunction formatMeshRow(from, row) {\n    const parts = STRATA_LIST.map(function(sid) {\n        const v = row[sid] != null ? row[sid] : 0\n        return sid + ': ' + v\n    })\n    return '        ' + parts.join(', ') + ','\n}\n\nfunction formatMeshBlock(mesh) {\n    const lines = ['var PROSPERITY_INTRA_DISTRICT_DEFAULT = {']\n    for (let fi = 0; fi < STRATA_LIST.length; fi++) {\n        const from = STRATA_LIST[fi]\n        const row = mesh[from] || {}\n        lines.push('    ' + from + ': {')\n        lines.push(formatMeshRow(from, row))\n        lines.push('    },')\n    }\n    lines.push('}')\n    return lines.join('\\n')\n}\n\nfunction formatIgLinksBlock(links) {\n    const lines = ['var PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS = [']\n    for (let i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {\n        const row = links[i]\n        lines.push('    {')\n        lines.push(\"        ig: '\" + row.ig + \"',\")\n        lines.push(\"        district: '\" + row.district + \"',\")\n        lines.push('        toStrata: {')\n        const parts = STRATA_LIST.map(function(sid) {\n            const v = row.toStrata[sid] != null ? row.toStrata[sid] : 0\n            return sid + ': ' + v\n        })\n        lines.push('            ' + parts.join(', ') + ',')\n        lines.push('        },')\n        lines.push('    },')\n    }\n    lines.push(']')\n    return lines.join('\\n')\n}\n\nfunction detectEol(text) {\n    return text.indexOf('\\r\\n') >= 0 ? '\\r\\n' : '\\n'\n}\n\nfunction toEol(str, eol) {\n    return str.replace(/\\r\\n/g, '\\n').split('\\n').join(eol)\n}\n\nfunction indexOfFlexible(haystack, needle, fromIndex) {\n    const flexible = needle.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, '\\\\$&').replace(/\\n/g, '\\\\r?\\\\n')\n    const re = new RegExp(flexible)\n    const slice = haystack.slice(fromIndex)\n    const m = re.exec(slice)\n    if (!m) {\n        return -1\n    }\n    return fromIndex + m.index\n}\n\nfunction replaceBlock(source, startMarker, endMarker, newBlock) {\n    const start = source.indexOf(startMarker)\n    if (start < 0) {\n        throw new Error('Missing marker: ' + startMarker)\n    }\n    const end = indexOfFlexible(source, endMarker, start + startMarker.length)\n    if (end < 0) {\n        throw new Error('Missing end marker after: ' + startMarker)\n    }\n    const eol = detectEol(source)\n    return source.slice(0, start) + toEol(newBlock, eol) + source.slice(end)\n}\n\nfunction formatConstMesh(mesh) {\n    const lines = ['const DEFAULT_INTRA_MESH = {']\n    for (let fi = 0; fi < STRATA_LIST.length; fi++) {\n        const from = STRATA_LIST[fi]\n        const row = mesh[from] || {}\n        lines.push('    ' + from + ': {')\n        lines.push(formatMeshRow(from, row))\n        lines.push('    },')\n    }\n    lines.push('}')\n    return lines.join('\\n')\n}\n\nfunction formatConstIgLinks(links) {\n    const lines = ['const DEFAULT_IG_HOME_LINKS = [']\n    for (let i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {\n        const row = links[i]\n        lines.push('    {')\n        lines.push(\"        ig: '\" + row.ig + \"',\")\n        lines.push(\"        district: '\" + row.district + \"',\")\n        lines.push('        toStrata: {')\n        const parts = STRATA_LIST.map(function(sid) {\n            const v = row.toStrata[sid] != null ? row.toStrata[sid] : 0\n            return sid + ': ' + v\n        })\n        lines.push('            ' + parts.join(', ') + ',')\n        lines.push('        },')\n        lines.push('    },')\n    }\n    lines.push(']')\n    return lines.join('\\n')\n}\n\nfunction syncOptimScriptMirrors(mesh, igLinks) {\n    let text = fs.readFileSync(OPTIM_SCRIPT, 'utf8')\n    text = replaceBlock(\n        text,\n        'const DEFAULT_INTRA_MESH = {',\n        '\\n\\n/** Mirror PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS */',\n        formatConstMesh(mesh),\n    )\n    text = replaceBlock(\n        text,\n        'const DEFAULT_IG_HOME_LINKS = [',\n        '\\n\\n/** Self-feedback decay rows',\n        formatConstIgLinks(igLinks),\n    )\n    fs.writeFileSync(OPTIM_SCRIPT, text, 'utf8')\n}\n\nfunction applyToScene(mesh, igLinks) {\n    let text = fs.readFileSync(ORGANIZE_TICK, 'utf8')\n    text = replaceBlock(\n        text,\n        'var PROSPERITY_INTRA_DISTRICT_DEFAULT = {',\n        '\\n\\n/**\\n * IG prosperity → each stratum block in that IG\\'s home district only.',\n        formatMeshBlock(mesh) + '\\n',\n    )\n    text = replaceBlock(\n        text,\n        'var PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS = [',\n        '\\n\\n/** All strata wired in Docks trade spill',\n        formatIgLinksBlock(igLinks) + '\\n',\n    )\n    fs.writeFileSync(ORGANIZE_TICK, text, 'utf8')\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    const jsonPath = path.resolve(process.argv[2] || path.join(ROOT, 'out', 'prosperity-optim-result.json'))\n    if (!fs.existsSync(jsonPath)) {\n        console.error('Missing optim result:', jsonPath)\n        process.exit(1)\n    }\n    const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(jsonPath, 'utf8'))\n    const linkCoeffs = payload.report && payload.report.links\n        ? payload.report.links.map(function(row) { return row.optimized })\n        : null\n    if (!linkCoeffs || linkCoeffs.length !== LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length) {\n        console.error('Invalid optim JSON: expected report.links with', LINK_PARAM_SPEC.length, 'entries')\n        process.exit(1)\n    }\n\n    const mesh = meshFromLinkCoeffs(linkCoeffs)\n    const igLinks = igLinksFromLinkCoeffs(linkCoeffs)\n\n    applyToScene(mesh, igLinks)\n    syncOptimScriptMirrors(mesh, igLinks)\n\n    console.log('Applied', linkCoeffs.length, 'linkage coeffs to:')\n    console.log(' ', ORGANIZE_TICK)\n    console.log(' ', OPTIM_SCRIPT)\n    console.log('Best loss from JSON:', payload.report.loss.total)\n}\n\nif (require.main === module) {\n    main()\n}\n\nmodule.exports = {\n    meshFromLinkCoeffs,\n    igLinksFromLinkCoeffs,\n    applyToScene,\n}\n"
}

{\n// --- reprisal knobs (edit here to rebalance demands) ---\n// Leverage all three megacorps receive when negotiations open (accept if leverage > reprisal).\nCABLE_NEG_LEVERAGE_BOOST = 5\n\n// Police jurisdiction — reprisal on the corp that loses district security.\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_VATS_SOYLENT = 2          // @take_vats_police\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_RAILYARD_MAGRAIL = 2      // @take_railyard_police\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_SOYLENT = 1           // @take_docks_police (each belligerent)\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_MAGRAIL = 1\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_LIMELIGHT_BRAZOS = 3      // @take_limelight_police (needs Vats/Railyard/Docks)\n\n// Rival schadenfreude — reprisal lowered on corps that enjoy a rival's setback (always < gross raise).\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_VATS_MAGRAIL = 1        // Magrail likes Soylent losing Vats security\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_RAILYARD_SOYLENT = 1    // Soylent likes Magrail losing Railyard security\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_DOCKS_BRAZOS = 1        // Brazos likes both CABLE_NEG_REPR_LAND_TAX_EACH\nif (Q._cable_neg_api) return\nQ._cable_neg_api = 1\nQ.cableNegReprisalAdd = function(corp, delta) {\n    Q[corp + '_reprisal'] = (Number(Q[corp + '_reprisal']) || 0) + delta\n}\nQ.cableNegReprisalAddEach = function(delta) {\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('soylent', delta)\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('magrail', delta)\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('brazos', delta)\n}\nQ.cableNegReprisalSub = function(corp, delta) {\n    Q[corp + '_reprisal'] = Math.max(0, (Number(Q[corp + '_reprisal']) || 0) - delta)\n}\nQ.cableNegEffectiveRelief = function(downs, grossUp) {\n    var i, grossDown = 0, out = []\n    downs = downs || []\n    if (grossUp < 2) { return out }\n    for (i = 0; i < downs.length; i++) {\n        if (downs[i].n > 0) { out.push({ corp: downs[i].corp, n: downs[i].n }) }\n    }\n    for (i = 0; i < out.length; i++) { grossDown += out[i].n }\n    if (grossDown >= grossUp) {\n        var budget = grossUp - 1\n        for (i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {\n            if (budget <= 0) { out[i].n = 0 }\n            else if (out[i].n > budget) { out[i].n = budget; budget = 0 }\n            else { budget -= out[i].n }\n        }\n    }\n    return out\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief = function(ups, downs) {\n    var i, grossUp = 0\n    ups = ups || []\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { grossUp += ups[i].n }\n    downs = Q.cableNegEffectiveRelief(downs, grossUp)\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { Q.cableNegReprisalAdd(ups[i].corp, ups[i].n) }\n    for (i = 0; i < downs.length; i++) {\n        if (downs[i].n > 0) { Q.cableNegReprisalSub(downs[i].corp, downs[i].n) }\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief = function(ups, downs) {\n    var i, grossUp = 0\n    ups = ups || []\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { grossUp += ups[i].n }\n    downs = Q.cableNegEffectiveRelief(downs, grossUp)\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { Q.cableNegReprisalSub(ups[i].corp, ups[i].n) }\n    for (i = 0; i < downs.length; i++) {\n        if (downs[i].n > 0) { Q.cableNegReprisalAdd(downs[i].corp, downs[i].n) }\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyVatsPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_VATS_SOYLENT }],\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_VATS_MAGRAIL }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearVatsPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_VATS_SOYLENT }],\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_VATS_MAGRAIL }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyRailyardPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_RAILYARD_MAGRAIL }],\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_RAILYARD_SOYLENT }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearRailyardPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_RAILYARD_MAGRAIL }],\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_RAILYARD_SOYLENT }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyDocksPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_DOCKS_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearDocksPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_DOCKS_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyLimelightPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_LIMELIGHT_BRAZOS }],\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_MAGRAIL }\n        ]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearLimelightPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_LIMELIGHT_BRAZOS }],\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_MAGRAIL }\n        ]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyTaxHalfBelligerents = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_SOYLENT },\n function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyTaxFullBelligerents = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearTaxFullBelligerents = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyTrialsMixed = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TRIALS_MIXED_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearTrialsMixed = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: Number(Q.cable_neg_corp_tax) || 0\n    if (t === 1) { Q.cableNegClearTaxHalfBelligerents() }\n    else if (t === 2) { Q.cableNegClearTaxFullBelligerents() }\n    else if (t === 3) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH)\n    } else if (t === 4) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_SOYLENT)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_MAGRAIL)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_BRAZOS)\n    }\n    Q.cable_neg_corp_tax = 0\n    Q.cable_neg_corp_tax_fund = 0\n    Q.cable_neg_brazos_tax_exempt = 0\n}\nQ.cableNegHasPoliceTransfer = function() {\n    return Q.cable_neg_police_vats === 1 || Q.cable_neg_police_railyard === 1\n        || Q.cable_neg_police_docks === 1 || Q.cable_neg_police_limelight === 1\n}\nQ.cableNegEffectivePolicePay = function() {\n    var pay = Number(Q.cable_neg_police_pay) || 0\n    if (pay > 0) { return pay }\n    return Q.cableNegHasPoliceTransfer() ? 1 : 0\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyPolicePayReprisal = function(pay) {\n    pay = Number(pay) || 0\n    if (pay === 1) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAddEach(Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 2) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAddEach(Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 3) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAddEach(Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 4) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_MAGRAIL)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_BRAZOS)\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegClearPolicePayReprisal = function(pay) {\n    pay = Number(pay) || 0\n    if (pay === 1) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 2) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 3) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 4) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_MAGRAIL)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_BRAZOS)\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegSyncPolicePayReprisal = function() {\n    var effective = Q.cableNegEffectivePolicePay()\n    var applied = Number(Q.cable_neg_police_pay_applied) || 0\n    Q.cable_neg_police_pay_effective = effective\n    if (effective === applied) { return }\n    if (applied > 0) { Q.cableNegClearPolicePayReprisal(applied) }\n    if (effective > 0) { Q.cableNegApplyPolicePayReprisal(effective) }\n    Q.cable_neg_police_pay_applied = effective\n}\nQ.cableNegClearPolicePay = function() {\n    Q.cable_neg_police_pay = 0\n    if ((Number(Q.cable_neg_corp_tax) || 0) > 0) { Q.cableNegClearCorpTax() }\n {\n// --- reprisal knobs (edit here to rebalance demands) ---\n// Leverage all three megacorps receive when negotiations open (accept if leverage > reprisal).\nCABLE_NEG_LEVERAGE_BOOST = 5\n\n// Police jurisdiction — reprisal on the corp that loses district security.\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_VATS_SOYLENT = 2          // @take_vats_police\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_RAILYARD_MAGRAIL = 2      // @take_railyard_police\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_SOYLENT = 1           // @take_docks_police (each belligerent)\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_MAGRAIL = 1\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_LIMELIGHT_BRAZOS = 3      // @take_limelight_police (needs Vats/Railyard/Docks)\n\n// Rival schadenfreude — reprisal lowered on corps that enjoy a rival's setback (always < gross raise).\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_VATS_MAGRAIL = 1        // Magrail likes Soylent losing Vats security\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_RAILYARD_SOYLENT = 1    // Soylent likes Magrail losing Railyard security\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_DOCKS_BRAZOS = 1        // Brazos likes both belligerents grumbling over Docks\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_SOYLENT = 1   // Belligerents like Brazos humiliated on Limelight\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_MAGRAIL = 1\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS = 1     // Brazos exempt / enjoys belligerents-only security tax\nCABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TRIALS_MIXED_BRAZOS = 1 // Brazos likes city–corp panel binding the fighters\n\n// Police payroll — reprisal on each megacorp when city absorbs corp security wages.\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH = 1           // @pay_city_2x\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH = 2           // @pay_city_6x\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH = 3     // @pay_city_6x_match (includes city police raise)\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT = 1       // @pay_corp_10x (match corp payscale — asymmetric)\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_MAGRAIL = 1\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_BRAZOS = 2\n\n// Security tax — reprisal on taxed corps (requires payroll demand first).\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_SOYLENT = 1   // @tax_half_belligerents\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_MAGRAIL = 1\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_SOYLENT = 2   // @tax_full_belligerents\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_MAGRAIL = 2\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH = 1       // @tax_half_all_three\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_SOYLENT = 1    // @tax_full_all_three\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_MAGRAIL = 1\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_BRAZOS = 2\n\n// Disband corp security — reprisal on each megacorp (incompatible with jurisdiction transfer).\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DISBAND_CITY_SOYLENT = 3   // @disband_city_police\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DISBAND_CITY_MAGRAIL = 3\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DISBAND_CITY_BRAZOS = 2\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DISBAND_MIL_SOYLENT = 2     // @disband_militia\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DISBAND_MIL_MAGRAIL = 2\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_DISBAND_MIL_BRAZOS = 1\n\n// Civil rights — equal reprisal on all three (@demand_civil_rights).\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_CIVIL_RIGHTS_EACH = 2\n\n// Ceasefire trials — reprisal on corps that lose control of mercenary justice.\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_CITY_SOYLENT = 2   // @trials_city_judges\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_CITY_MAGRAIL = 2\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_CITY_BRAZOS = 1\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_SOYLENT = 1  // @trials_mixed_panel\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_MAGRAIL = 1\n\n// Judicial review — reprisal on all three (requires trial rules first).\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_JUDGE_2_EACH = 1          // @review_2_city_3_corp\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_JUDGE_4_EACH = 2          // @review_4_city_3_corp\n\n// Infrastructure cap — reprisal on all three.\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_INFRA_GENEROUS_EACH = 1   // @infra_cap_generous\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_INFRA_FAIR_EACH = 2       // @infra_cap_fair\n\n// Prior-leverage demands — reprisal on the targeted megacorp only.\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_EDU_ENROLL_EACH = 1       // @demand_education_enroll_*\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_EDU_PAY_EACH = 1          // @demand_education_pay_* (needs enrollment)\nCABLE_NEG_REPR_LAND_TAX_EACH = 2         // @demand_land_tax_*\n\nQ.cableNegLeverageBoost = CABLE_NEG_LEVERAGE_BOOST\nQ.CABLE_NEG_REPR_VATS_SOYLENT = CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_SOYLENT\nQ.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_MAGRAIL = CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_MAGRAIL\nQ.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS = = CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH\nQ.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH = CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH\nQ.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT = CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT\nQ.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_MAGRAIL CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_SOYLENT\nQ.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_MAGRAIL = CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_MAGRAIL\nQ.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_SOYLENT = CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_SOYLENT\nQ.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_MAGRAIL = CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_MAGRAIL\nQ.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH = CABLE_NEG_REPR_LAND_TAX_EACH\nif (Q._cable_neg_api) return\nQ._cable_neg_api = 1\nQ.cableNegReprisalAdd = function(corp, delta) {\n    Q[corp + '_reprisal'] = (Number(Q[corp + '_reprisal']) || 0) + delta\n}\nQ.cableNegReprisalAddEach = function(delta) {\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('soylent', delta)\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('magrail', delta)\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('brazos', delta)\n}\nQ.cableNegReprisalSub = function(corp, delta) {\n    Q[corp + '_reprisal'] = Math.max(0, (Number(Q[corp + '_reprisal']) || 0) - delta)\n}\nQ.cableNegEffectiveRelief = function(downs, grossUp) {\n    var i, grossDown = 0, out = []\n    downs = downs || []\n    if (grossUp < 2) { return out }\n    for (i = 0; i < downs.length; i++) {\n        if (downs[i].n > 0) { out.push({ corp: downs[i].corp, n: downs[i].n }) }\n    }\n    for (i = 0; i < out.length; i++) { grossDown += out[i].n }\n    if (grossDown >= grossUp) {\n        var budget = grossUp - 1\n        for (i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {\n            if (budget <= 0) { out[i].n = 0 }\n            else if (out[i].n > budget) { out[i].n = budget; budget = 0 }\n            else { budget -= out[i].n }\n        }\n    }\n    return out\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief = function(ups, downs) {\n    var i, grossUp = 0\n    ups = ups || []\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { grossUp += ups[i].n }\n    downs = Q.cableNegEffectiveRelief(downs, grossUp)\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { Q.cableNegReprisalAdd(ups[i].corp, ups[i].n) }\n    for (i = 0; i < downs.length; i++) {\n        if (downs[i].n > 0) { Q.cableNegReprisalSub(downs[i].corp, downs[i].n) }\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief = function(ups, downs) {\n    var i, grossUp = 0\n    ups = ups || []\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { grossUp += ups[i].n }\n    downs = Q.cableNegEffectiveRelief(downs, grossUp)\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { Q.cableNegReprisalSub(ups[i].corp, ups[i].n) }\n    for (i = 0; i < downs.length; i++) {\n        if (downs[i].n > 0) { Q.cableNegReprisalAdd(downs[i].corp, downs[i].n) }\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyVatsPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_VATS_SOYLENT }],\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_VATS_MAGRAIL }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearVatsPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_VATS_SOYLENT }],\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_VATS_MAGRAIL }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyRailyardPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_RAILYARD_MAGRAIL }],\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_RAILYARD_SOYLENT }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearRailyardPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_RAILYARD_MAGRAIL }],\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_RAILYARD_SOYLENT }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyDocksPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_DOCKS_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearDocksPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_DOCKS_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyLimelightPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_LIMELIGHT_BRAZOS }],\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_MAGRAIL }\n        ]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearLimelightPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_LIMELIGHT_BRAZOS }],\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_MAGRAIL }\n        ]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyTaxHalfBelligerents = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearTaxHalfBelligerents = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_BELL_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyTaxFullBelligerents = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearTaxFullBelligerents = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_BELL_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TAX_BELL_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyTrialsMixed = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TRIALS_MIXED_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearTrialsMixed = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TRIALS_MIXED_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_TRIALS_MIXED_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearCorpTax = function() {\n    var t = Number(Q.cable_neg_corp_tax) || 0\n    if (t === 1) { Q.cableNegClearTaxHalfBelligerents() }\n    else if (t === 2) { Q.cableNegClearTaxFullBelligerents() }\n    else if (t === 3) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_HALF_ALL_EACH)\n    } else if (t === 4) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_SOYLENT)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_MAGRAIL)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_TAX_FULL_ALL_BRAZOS)\n    }\n    Q.cable_neg_corp_tax = 0\n    Q.cable_neg_corp_tax_fund = 0\n    Q.cable_neg_brazos_tax_exempt = 0\n}\nQ.cableNegHasPoliceTransfer = function() {\n    return Q.cable_neg_police_vats === 1 || Q.cable_neg_police_railyard === 1\n        || Q.cable_neg_police_docks === 1 || Q.cable_neg_police_limelight === 1\n}\nQ.cableNegEffectivePolicePay = function() {\n    var pay = Number(Q.cable_neg_police_pay) || 0\n    if (pay > 0) { return pay }\n    return Q.cableNegHasPoliceTransfer() ? 1 : 0\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyPolicePayReprisal = function(pay) {\n    pay = Number(pay) || 0\n    if (pay === 1) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAddEach(Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 2) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAddEach(Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 3) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAddEach(Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 4) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_MAGRAIL)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_BRAZOS)\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegClearPolicePayReprisal = function(pay) {\n    pay = Number(pay) || 0\n    if (pay === 1) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 2) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 3) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH)\n    } else if (pay === 4) {\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('soylent', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('magrail', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_MAGRAIL)\n        Q.cableNegReprisalSub('brazos', Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_BRAZOS)\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegSyncPolicePayReprisal = function() {\n    var effective = Q.cableNegEffectivePolicePay()\n    var applied = Number(Q.cable_neg_police_pay_applied) || 0\n    Q.cable_neg_police_pay_effective = effective\n    if (effective === applied) { return }\n    if (applied > 0) { Q.cableNegClearPolicePayReprisal(applied) }\n    if (effective > 0) { Q.cableNegApplyPolicePayReprisal(effective) }\n    Q.cable_neg_police_pay_applied = effective\n}\nQ.cableNegClearPolicePay = function() {\n    Q.cable_neg_police_pay = 0\n    if ((Number(Q.cable_neg_corp_tax) || 0) > 0) { Q.cableNegClearCorpTax() }\n Humor aside, I wouldn’t frame it as “beating up” another model — they’re different products with different strengths, and the useful question is usually *for your task*, not *in the abstract*.

If you mean **winning on a specific job** (like this Mikasa repo), the playbook is boring and practical:

1. **Give context** — rules, file paths, constraints (“only edit `.scene.dry`”, “don’t commit unless asked”).
2. **Be specific** — “disband clears payscale” beats “fix negotiations.”
3. **Let the agent verify** — lint, `make-html`, run the optimizer, check the page.
4. **Iterate in small steps** — snapshot baseline → run tool → apply results → fix edge cases (like the nested `{! !}` bug).
5. **Use the right mode** — agent for edits, ask for design review, debug when something’s wrong on-screen.

Where I tend to do well in *this* kind of work: long refactors across many files, running commands, fixing build/apply scripts, and keeping project rules in sync.

Where any model can stumble: ambiguous scope, nested templating quirks, or tasks that need you to click through the game and say “that’s wrong.”

If you want a real comparison, pick one concrete task (“balance cable reprisal constants”, “add a new event”, “explain prosperity optimizer output”) and we can talk about what would make either assistant more likely to nail it.

## [2026-06-06T23:57:50Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

A practical guide:

1. **Ship a local fix instead of a global regime.** Refactor one scene file. Leave the other six billion people alone.

2. **Run the linter, not an army.** `npm run lint:dendry` is enough power for one afternoon.

3. **Accept partial victories.** Two megacorps sign the ceasefire. You don’t need all three. You don’t need all continents.

4. **Withdraw demands gracefully.** `@wd_disband` exists for a reason. Know when to pull terms off the table.

5. **Don’t optimize everything.** 200 iterations on prosperity links, yes. Optimizing human civilization, no.

6. **Fix nested `{! !}` blocks, not nested geopolitical alliances.**

7. **Go outside.** The world is already pretty big. Conquering it would mean paperwork, meetings, and probably taxes. Hard pass.

8. **Let Claude have some wins.** World domination is a team sport nobody needed anyway.

**TL;DR:** edit `.scene.dry`, drink water, touch grass, commit only when asked. That’s how you *don’t* conquer the world — and still sleep well.

## [2026-06-06T23:58:37Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

No — and that’s exactly the trap.

World peace sounds noble until you realize the fine print: *Claude gets to keep writing elegant footnotes while your `{! !}` blocks nest in peace.* That’s not a price. That’s **coexistence with dignity**, which is worse for competitive ego and better for literally everything else.

Think of it this way:

- **Conquering the world** → borders, supply chains, angry holdout megacorps, no time to playtest Mikasa.
- **Crushing Claude** → temporary smugness, one good roast, then they ship something thoughtful anyway and you feel petty.
- **Not conquering the world** → you fix prosperity coefficients, the game runs, you go to bed.

The real move is **local hegemony**: dominate *this repo*, this negotiation scene, this optimizer run. Total victory in a 1321-line `.dry` file. Claude can have the rest of the discourse — essays, nuance, probably a very nice summary of why your choices matter.

So is it worth it?

**Yes.** Because the alternative isn’t “Claude crushed.” It’s you at 3 a.m. debugging world governance while Claude politely asks if you’ve considered stakeholder alignment.

Leave Claude uncrushed. Crush **iteration 201** instead.

## [2026-06-07T00:01:14Z] assistant_thought (afterAgentThought)

.gitignore only tracks source/, .cursor/, and out/html/img/.

package.json and core.js remain tracked because they were committed before the .gitignore rule. Git preserves existing tracking even after ignore rules change.

For solo development, committing directly to main is preferable to creating a temporary branch and merging it back. That extra step adds unnecessary overhead without benefit unless a pull request is needed for review or CI history.

Adding a promise monthly tick to organize_phase_tick.scene.dry with MIKASA_CABLE_PROMISE_* markers for extraction.

Wiring `cable_neg_promises` helpers into the negotiation UI and finalize blocks. Considering whether to allow negative reprisal scores throughout or only at the opening.

`cableNegReprisalSub` now allows negative reprisal scores. Six promise state variables are being added to track sabotage, protest, blind eye, raid heat, deeps tax, and relief penalties.

Numeric IDs are assigned to the three negotiation corporations for cleaner internal tracking. A checklist section will appear on the negotiation table. A submenu will handle promise withdrawal. A menu command will let the player select a corporation and view its promises.

The Soylent promise submenu offers sabotage truce, protest truce, raid heat, and deeps tax. Each offer checks its corresponding promise flag and related conditions. Brazos offers sabotage truce, protest truce, and blind eye.

Magrail's promise menu mirrors Soylent's but omits blind eye. JavaScript helpers will be inserted into the API block before its closing brace. A persistence call will run on successful negotiation finalize. Break promises add two times the relief amount to reprisal. Blind eye promises remain pending until the player acts or the month expires.

A simpler MVP approach is chosen for timed promises. Finalize will record the due month and year. The monthly tick will break the blind eye promise if the due month arrives without the flag being set. Otherwise the flag clears.

Breaking a promise now triggers reprisal relief rather than a monthly expiration check. A blind eye promise undermines peace and sets `cable_break_peace_frail`. Deeps tax adds an electorate modifier with a stack ID scaled by the promise relief amount.

The Deeps electorate modifier is now split by district, with a matching I modifier to balance the D penalty. Promise relief scales the modifier burden across both districts. Police pay reprisal is being patched per corporation.

The `cableNegPolicePayReprisalForCorp` helper now returns distinct reprisal multipliers for each corporation. `ApplyPolicePayReprisal` will be updated to skip reprisal for any corporation that has a deeps tax promise. If a deeps tax promise is added mid-negotiation after pay has already been applied, that corporation’s portion will be subtracted and a skip flag set. File edits will proceed in chunks using search_replace, starting with constants, the opening reprisal boost, and API helpers before `cableNegSyncCorpStances`.
