Done. Here’s what changed:

**Opening table shift**
- Crisis leverage boost: **5 → 3**
- Each megacorp’s reprisal: **−2** at negotiations open (can go negative; `cableNegReprisalSub` no longer floors at 0)

**Promises menu** (`@corp_promises` on the terms table)
Each promise type is **global-exclusive** (one corp only). Reprisal drops immediately; breaking one later adds **2×** the relief back.

| Promise | Who | Scaling / rules |
|---------|-----|-----------------|
| Saboteur truce | Any corp | `sabotage` training level (1–3) |
| Protest truce | Any corp | `non_violence` training level (1–3) |
| Blind eye to syndicate op | **Brazos only** | Fixed −2; due next month; frays peace |
| Absorb raid heat | **Soylent or Magrail** | Fixed −2; due in 3 months; **blocked if disbanding police** |
| Deeps tax farming | Any corp | Waives that corp’s **police payroll reprisal**; sets `cable_deeps_tax_burden` for Deeps **D→I** shift (−0.12 / +0.12 per burden point) |

**Other wiring**
- Promises show on the demands checklist (→ entries)
- Withdraw submenu for each promise type
- Successful deal calls `cableNegPersistPromises()` — sets `cable_promise_*` flags for card hooks and monthly enforcement
- `monthly_tick_phase1` runs `cableNegPromiseMonthlyTick()` — auto-breaks timed blind-eye / raid-heat promises if not honored by the due month
- Deeps electorate modifiers added in `electorate_runtime.scene.dry`

**Not fully wired yet** (flags exist for follow-up): sabotage/protest **cards** checking `cable_promise_block_*` before hitting a promised corp, and honor events for blind-eye / raid-heat. The negotiation math and persistence are in place.

{\n// --- reprisal knobs (edit here to rebalance demands) ---\n// Leverage all three megacorps receive when negotiations open (accept if leverage > reprisal).\nCABLE_NEG_LEVERAGE_BOOST = 3\n// Reprisal on each megacorp shaved at the table opening (may go negative).\nCABLE_NEG_OPENING_REPRISAL_RELIEF = 2\n\n// Promise enticements — reprisal relief while bargaining; 2× back if broken function(corp, delta) {\n    Q[corp + '_reprisal'] = (Number(Q[corp + '_reprisal']) || 0) + delta\n}\nQ.cableNegReprisalAddEach = function(delta) {\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('soylent', delta)\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('magrail', delta)\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd('brazos', delta)\n}\nQ.cableNegReprisalSub = function(corp, delta) {\n    Q[corp + '_reprisal'] = (Number(Q[corp + '_reprisal']) || 0) - delta\n}\nQ.cableNegCorpId = function(corp) {\n    if (corp === 'soylent') { return 1 }\n    if (corp === 'magrail') { return 2 }\n    if (corp === 'brazos') { return 3 }\n    return 0\n}\nQ.cableNegCorpName = function(id) {\n    id = Number(id) || 0\n    if (id === 1) { return 'soylent' }\n    if (id === 2) { return 'magrail' }\n    if (id === 3) { return 'brazos' }\n    return ''\n}\nQ.cableNegPolicePayReprisalForCorp = function(corp, pay) {\n    pay = Number(pay) || 0\n    if (pay === 1) { return Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_2X_EACH }\n    if (pay === 2) { return Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_EACH }\n    if (pay === 3) { return Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_6X_MATCH_EACH }\n    if (pay === 4) {\n        if (corp === 'soylent') { return Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_SOYLENT }\n        if (corp === 'magrail') { return Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_MAGRAIL }\n        if (corp === 'brazos') { return Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_PAY_10X_BRAZOS }\n    }\n    return 0\n}\nQ.cableNegPromiseRelief = function(kind, corp) {\n    corp = corp || ''\n    if (kind === 'sabotage') { return Math.max(0, Number(Q.sabotage) || 0) }\n    if (kind === 'protest') { return Math.max(0, Number(Q.non_violence) || 0) }\n    if (kind === 'blind_eye') { return Q.CABLE_NEG_PROMISE_BLIND_EYE_RELIEF }\n    if (kind === 'raid_heat') { return Q.CABLE_NEG_PROMISE_RAID_HEAT_RELIEF }\n    if (kind === 'deeps_tax') {\n        return Q.cableNegPolicePayReprisalForCorp(corp, Q.cableNegEffectivePolicePay())\n    }\n    return 0\n}\nQ.cableNegPromiseCorpField = function(kind) {\n    return 'cable_neg_promise_' + kind + '_corp'\n}\nQ.cableNegPromiseReliefField = function(kind) {\n    return 'cable_neg_promise_' + kind + '_relief'\n}\nQ.cableNegPromiseTaken = function(kind) {\n    return (Number(Q[Q.cableNegPromiseCorpField(kind)]) || 0) > 0\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyPromise = function(kind, corp) {\n    var id = Q.cableNegCorpId(corp)\n    if (!id || Q.cableNegPromiseTaken(kind)) { return 0 }\n    var relief = Q.cableNegPromiseRelief(kind, corp)\n    if (relief <= 0) { return 0 }\n    Q[Q.cableNegPromiseCorpField(kind)] = id\n    Q[Q.cableNegPromiseReliefField(kind)] = relief\n    Q.cableNegReprisalSub(corp, relief)\n    if (kind === 'deeps_tax') { Q.cableNegSyncPolicePayReprisal() }\n    return relief\n}\nQ.cableNegClearPromise = function(kind) {\n    var id = Number(Q[Q.cableNegPromiseCorpField(kind)]) || 0\n    if (id <= 0) { return }\n    var corp = Q.cableNegCorpName(id)\n    var relief = Number(Q[Q.cableNegPromiseReliefField(kind)]) || 0\n    if (relief > 0) { Q.cableNegReprisalAdd(corp, relief) }\n    Q[Q.cableNegPromiseCorpField(kind)] = 0\n    Q[Q.cableNegPromiseReliefField(kind)] = 0\n    if (kind === 'deeps_tax') { Q.cableNegSyncPolicePayReprisal() }\n}\nQ.cableNegDeepsTaxCorp = function() {\n    return Q.cableNegCorpName(Number(Q.cable_neg_promise_deeps_tax_corp) || 0)\n}\nQ.cableNegPersistPromises = function() {\n    var kinds = ['sabotage', 'protest', 'blind_eye', 'raid_heat', 'deeps_tax']\n    var i, kind, id, corp, relief\n    for (i = 0; i < kinds.length; i++) {\n        kind = kinds[i]\n        id = Number(Q[Q.cableNegPromiseCorpField(kind)]) || 0\n        corp = Q.cableNegCorpName(id)\n        relief = Number(Q[Q.cableNegPromiseReliefField(kind)]) || 0\n        Q['cable_promise_' + kind + '_corp'] = corp\n        Q['cable_promise_' + kind + '_relief'] = relief\n        if (corp) {\n            Q['cable_promise_block_' + kind + '_' + corp] = 1\n        }\n    }\n    if ((Number(Q.cable_neg_promise_blind_eye_corp) || 0) > 0) {\n        Q.cable_break_peace_frail = 1\n        Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_due_month = (Number(Q.month) || 0) + 1\n        Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_due_year = Number(Q.year) || 0\n        if (Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_due_month > 12) {\n            Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_due_month -= 12\n            Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_due_year += 1\n        }\n    }\n    if ((Number(Q.cable_neg_promise_raid_heat_corp) || 0) > 0) {\n        Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_due_month = (Number(Q.month) || 0) + 3\n        Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_due_year = Number(Q.year) || 0\n        while (Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_due_month > 12) {\n            Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_due_month -= 12\n            Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_due_year += 1\n        }\n    }\n    corp = Q.cableNegDeepsTaxCorp()\n    if (corp) {\n        Q.cable_deeps_tax_burden = Number(Q.cable_neg_promise_deeps_tax_relief) || 0\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegBreakPromise = function(kind) {\n    var corp = Q['cable_promise_' + kind + '_corp']\n    var relief = Number(Q['cable_promise_' + kind + '_relief']) || 0\n    if (!corp || relief <= 0 || Q['cable_promise_' + kind + '_broken'] === 1) { return }\n    Q['cable_promise_' + kind + '_broken'] = 1\n    Q.cableNegReprisalAdd(corp, relief * 2)\n    if (Q['cable_promise_block_' + kind + '_' + corp] === 1) {\n        Q['cable_promise_block_' + kind + '_' + corp] = 0\n    }\n    if (kind === 'deeps_tax') { Q.cable_deeps_tax_burden = 0 }\n}\nQ.cableNegPromiseMonthlyTick = function() {\n    if (Q.cable_break_peace !== 1) { return }\n    var m = Number(Q.month) || 0\n    var y = Number(Q.year) || 0\n    if (Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_corp\n        && Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_honored !== 1\n        && Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_broken !== 1\n        && m === (Number(Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_due_month) || 0)\n        && y === (Number(Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_due_year) || 0)) {\n        Q.cableNegBreakPromise('blind_eye')\n        Q.cable_promise_blind_eye_broken = 1\n        Q.cable_break_peace_frail = 1\n    }\n    if (Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_corp\n        && Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_honored !== 1\n        && Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_broken !== 1\n        && m === (Number(Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_due_month) || 0)\n        && y === (Number(Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_due_year) || 0)) {\n        Q.cableNegBreakPromise('raid_heat')\n        Q.cable_promise_raid_heat_broken = 1\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegEffectiveRelief = function(downs, grossUp) {\n    var i, grossDown = 0, out = []\n    downs = downs || []\n    if (grossUp < 2) { return out }\n    for (i = 0; i < downs.length; i++) {\n        if (downs[i].n > 0) { out.push({ corp: downs[i].corp, n: downs[i].n }) }\n    }\n    for (i = 0; i < out.length; i++) { grossDown += out[i].n }\n    if (grossDown >= grossUp) {\n        var budget = grossUp - 1\n        for (i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {\n            if (budget <= 0) { out[i].n = 0 }\n            else if (out[i].n > budget) { out[i].n = budget; budget = 0 }\n            else { budget -= out[i].n }\n        }\n    }\n    return out\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief = function(ups, downs) {\n    var i, grossUp = 0\n    ups = ups || []\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { grossUp += ups[i].n }\n    downs = Q.cableNegEffectiveRelief(downs, grossUp)\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { Q.cableNegReprisalAdd(ups[i].corp, ups[i].n) }\n    for (i = 0; i < downs.length; i++) {\n        if (downs[i].n > 0) { Q.cableNegReprisalSub(downs[i].corp, downs[i].n) }\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief = function(ups, downs) {\n    var i, grossUp = 0\n    ups = ups || []\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { grossUp += ups[i].n }\n    downs = Q.cableNegEffectiveRelief(downs, grossUp)\n    for (i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) { Q.cableNegReprisalSub(ups[i].corp, ups[i].n) }\n    for (i = 0; i < downs.length; i++) {\n        if (downs[i].n > 0) { Q.cableNegReprisalAdd(downs[i].corp, downs[i].n) }\n    }\n}\nQ.cableNegApplyVatsPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_VATS_SOYLENT }],\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_VATS_MAGRAIL }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearVatsPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_VATS_SOYLENT }],\n        [{ corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_VATS_MAGRAIL }]\n 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_MAGRAIL }\n        ],\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_DOCKS_BRAZOS }]\n    )\n}\nQ.cableNegClearDocksPolice = function() {\n    Q.cableNegUndoWithRivalRelief(\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_DOCKS_SOYLENT },\n            { corp: 'magrail', n: Q.cableNegApplyWithRivalRelief(\n        [{ corp: 'brazos', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_REPR_LIMELIGHT_BRAZOS }],\n        [\n            { corp: 'soylent', n: Q.CABLE_NEG_RELIEF_LIMELIGHT_SOYLENT },\n t < targets.length; t++) {\n            var block = targets[t]\n            var fromBlocks = this.blocksMatching(state, this.fromScope, this.fromTarget)\n            var matchesFrom = false\n            for (var f = 0; These tilt the hub toward one belligerent; they don’t set `cable_break_peace_frail`.

### Timed promise that can blow up (violence-adjacent)

5. **Take syndicate raid heat** (Soylent or Magrail, 3 months) — `@offer_raid_heat_soylent` / `@offer_raid_heat_magrail`  
   - Requires **not** disbanding corp security  
   - Due in 3 months: if not honored, auto-breaks with **2× reprisal** (no `peace_frail` flag)  
   - Design note: syndicate raid heat — Brazos doesn’t want this one  

### Failing to get a deal at all

6. **Close the bargain** with fewer than 2 corps accepting (`leverage ≤ reprisal`)  
   - `@deal_failed`: *“Violence in the Vats and Railyard may continue…”*  
   - `cable_break_peace = 0` — no ceasefire  

7. **Any demand stack** that pushes reprisal above leverage for a walking corp  
   - Event text: a third who refuses *“may strike back immediately”*  
   - On finalize: that corp’s leverage −1 if they walked while reprisal > leverage  

Hard demands (police takeover, disband, taxes, trials, etc.) raise reprisal and can cause (6) or (7), but they aren’t individually tagged as “more violence.”

---

## After the deal — breaking promises you made at the table

Not in the negotiation event itself, but unlocked by promises from it — **Activist Training** card:

- Break saboteur truce — Soylent / Magrail / Brazos  
- Break protest truce — Soylent / Magrail / Brazos  

Each applies **double reprisal** immediately and clears the ceasefire block on that corp.

---

## Design doc vs implemented

From `cable_negotiations_thinking.md`, these were *intended* to undermine peace:

| Option | In event? | Peace/violence hook |
|--------|-----------|---------------------|
| Blind eye (Brazos) | Yes | Explicit + `peace_frail` |
| Brazos Docks DMZ | Yes | Explicit + `peace_frail` |
| Raid heat (Soyl/Mag) | Yes | Timed auto-break; no `peace_frail` |
| Disband → militia | Yes (`@disband_militia`) | Not flagged in code yet |

**Note:** `cable_break_peace_frail` is set in several places but nothing else in `source/` reads it yet — it’s a planted flag for future events. Likewise, `cable_promise_blind_eye_honored` / `cable_promise_raid_heat_honored` are never set, so those timed promises currently always break when due unless you add honor paths later.

If you want, I can map which **demands** (not promises) are highest-risk for failing the talks or triggering a walking corp’s reprisal strike.

## [2026-06-07T09:39:05Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

Added three timed events wired to the promise schedule set at deal close.

### Scheduling (on finalize in `cableNegPersistPromises`)
- **Blind eye:** `cable_promise_blind_eye_due_month` / `_due_year` = negotiation month + 1  
- **Raid heat:** `cable_promise_raid_heat_due_month` / `_due_year` = month + 3  
- Also sets `cable_syndicate_blind_eye_pending`, `cable_syndicate_raid_heat_pending`, and `cable_syndicate_raid_heat_corp_id` (1 = Soylent, 2 = Magrail)

Each month, `cableNegPromiseMonthlyTick` sets `cable_promise_*_event_ready = 1` when the calendar matches those stored dates (no longer auto-breaks the promise).

### Events (`source/scenes/events/`)

1. **`cable_syndicate_blind_eye.scene.dry`** — Brazos blind-eye promise  
   - Sharks hit Magrail (3 Railyard assets destroyed)  
   - Sharks gain Docks smuggling wharf  
   - Citywide + Docks public-support hit, Docks/Magrail prosperity down  
   - Soylent leverage & reprisal −1 each  

2. **`cable_syndicate_raid_magrail.scene.dry`** — Raid heat for Magrail  
   - Sharks: +3 reprisal, prosperity hit, lose Deeps asset  
   - Edges: leverage −1 (floor 0), small prosperity boost  
   - Citywide + Deeps backlash  

3. **`cable_syndicate_raid_soylent.scene.dry`** — Raid heat for Soylent  
   - **Opening choice:** accept/decline Seven Families + police/militia Pitts patrols  
   - Accept → `families_leverage` +1, Families prosperity bump  
   - Then raid: Edges & Sharks each lose asset, prosperity, gain reprisal; citywide + Railyard + Deeps backlash  

All three mark the promise **honored** (not broken) and set `cable_promise_*_event_done = 1`. Electorate backlash stacks live in `electorate_runtime.scene.dry`.

## [2026-06-07T10:11:05Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

The usual symbols:

- **Nu (ν)** — Greek lowercase nu: **ν** (Unicode `U+03BD`). In SI it’s the symbol for **frequency** (hertz is s⁻¹, but ν is often used for frequency in physics).
- **Yen** — **¥** (Unicode `U+00A5`). In Japanese you’ll also see **円** for the word *yen* itself.

For in-game currency like “nuYen”, common options are **ν¥**, **ν¥199**, or **199 ν¥**.

## [2026-06-07T14:16:28Z] assistant_thought (afterAgentThought)

Mapping out the game flow structure. The sequence begins at root, then moves through setup, and finally reaches main.

Clarified the exact entry path: root routes to setup functions, then main. The first play sequence runs 2300_main → setup → main. Noted that organize_phase_start is a manual event with no view-if condition, so it could potentially fire from the event pool at any point after its first visit.

2300_main_continue appears to be an orphaned dead path, since nothing in the main flow links back to it. The organize_phase_start event fires as a first-time event without a date gate. The timeline to the February 2302 refugee crisis spans roughly 28 months from January 2300. The events calendar starts with Game start in 2300-01.

The full events calendar is now mapped through the refugee crisis. Key milestones include the migrations card, the September convention, cable breaks, the Dundalk affair, and both orc marriages. The Titan crisis begins in February 2302. The goal is to reach a playable state by January 2302. The first remaining gap is being listed.

The phase system locks the City Affairs deck because it never advances past phase 1. The shuffle_cabinet scene still uses stale SPD conditions. The mikasa_journey_inbound stub needs real content or removal before February 2302. The corp_conflict scene appears orphaned and lacks a tagged event. The drone_vote_buying trigger is missing its year field, so it likely fires every December. Cable negotiation scenes still need budget logic from security taxes and disband flags. The organizing_unlock path between organize_phase_start and main remains unresolved. The refugees earth and otherworld scenes contain only one choice each. The third wave stratum may need integration into the election system.

  "content": "# Mikasa — implementation roadmap\n\nLiving inventory of what exists in `source/`, plus a plan to reach the **refugee crisis opening** ([`refugees_titan.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry), February 2302).\n\n**Monthly loop:** [`advance.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advance.scene.dry) → [`post_event.scene.dry`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) (tick + `#event` queue) → [`main.scene.dry`](source/scenes/main.scene.dry).\n\n**New game:** [`root.scene.dry`](source/scenes/root.scene.dry) `@start` → runtime bootstrap [`setup_functions.scene.dry`](source/scenes/setup_functions.scene.dry) → [`main.scene.dry`](source/scenes/main.scene.dry). Prologue text continues at [`root.scene.dry`](source/scenes/root.scene.dry) `@2300_main_continue` → [`organize_phase_start.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry).\n\n---\n\n## Background / runtime mechanics\n\nThese scenes load once (or each boot), define APIs on `Q`, and are not player-facing cards.\n\n| Mechanic | Scene | Notes |\n|--------|--------|--------|\n| Boot orchestration | [`setup_functions.scene.dry`](source/scenes/setup_functions.scene.dry) | Chains runtime scenes until election, electorate, economic, attitude, and organize APIs exist. |\n| Election v2 (tabulation, seats, projections) | [`election_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) | Source of truth for voter blocks, districts, IG boosts. Dev mirror: `source/lib/election-v2.js`. |\n| Electorate modifier catalog | [`electorate_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry) | `ElectorateModifier` rows; stacks from story choices (`dundalk_*`, contracts, cable neg, refugee prep, …). |\n| Economic assets & housing | [`economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry) | `Q.addAsset` / `Q.addHome`, Jacobs report, monthly housing, budget hooks. |\n| IG leverage / reprisal → attitude labels | [`attitude_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/attitude_runtime.scene.dry) | `Q.syncIgAttitudes()`, used in [`status.scene.dry`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry). |\n| Monthly economy & prosperity mesh | [`organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry) | `Q.monthly_tick_phase1`: trade level, prosperity connections, contracting allowance, cable promise tick, cable syndicate event-ready flags. Catalog doc: [`prosperity_connection_catalog.md`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md). |\n| District map (special UI) | [`district_map_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/district_map_runtime.scene.dry), [`district_map.scene.dry`](source/scenes/district_map.scene.dry) | Map overlay support. |\n| Mod loader hook | [`mod_loader.scene.dry`](source/scenes/mod_loader.scene.dry) | Shell integration. |\n| Corp conflict infra tick (legacy) | [`background/corp_conflict.scene.dry`](source/scenes/background/corp_conflict.scene.dry) | Mutates `district*_infra` from corp relations; **not wired into post_event tick**. |\n| Journey chapter gate (stub) | [`background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry) | Sets `mikasa_journey_leg`; triggered from [`post_event.scene.dry`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) at 2302-01+. |\n| Election scheduling helper | [`set_next_election_time.scene.dry`](source/scenes/set_next_election_time.scene.dry) | Internal / dev. |\n| Q-display labels | [`source/qdisplays/*.qdisplay.dry`](source/qdisplays/) | Month names, prosperity bands, attitudes, parochialism, etc. |\n| Game metadata | [`source/info.dry`](source/info.dry) | Title / author for build. |\n\n**UI / meta (not simulation):** [`status.scene.dry`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry), [`library.scene.dry`](source/scenes/library.scene.dry), [`election_simulation.scene.dry`](source/scenes/election_simulation.scene.dry), [`game_over.scene.dry`](source/scenes/game_over.scene.dry), Optionally tie [`organize_phase_tick`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry) trade-level `phase` bands to calendar elsewhere.\n2. **Replace or remove SPD leftovers** — Rewrite [`shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry) for Mikasa council, or drop from `#city_affairs` until designed.\n3. **Fix [`organize_phase_start`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry) entry** — Either gate it to Jan 2300 month 1 (first `post_event`) or chain explicitly from [`root`](source/scenes/root.scene.dry) `@2300_main_continue` so `organizing_unlock` is guaranteed before October events.\n4. **Date-gate [`drone_vote_buying`](source/scenes/background/drone_vote_buying.dry)** — Add `year`, `max-visits`, or remove until designed; avoid firing every December forever.\n\n### Phase B — 2300–2301 story spine (content)\n\n5. **September Convention fallout** — Ensure [`september_convention`](source/scenes/events/september_convention.scene.dry) stacks (`patriot_meme_strength`, etc.) connect to electorate modifiers already in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry) or add missing rows.\n6. **Migrations card window** — [`migrations`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry) expires Jun 2300; confirm that's intentional or extend / add successor card.\n7. **Cable arc polish** — Close negotiation TODOs (tax → budget, disband flags); smoke-test syndicate timed events from a Jun 2301 deal through +1 / +3 months.\n8. **Dundalk + orc events** — [`mss_dundalk_affair`](source/scenes/events/mss_dundalk_affair.scene.dry), [`orc_marriage1/2`](source/scenes/events/orc_marriage1.scene.dry) — verify electorate stacks and martyrs list integrate with [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry) / future content.\n\n### Phase C — Bridge to 2302 (refugee runway)\n\n9. **Implement [`mikasa_journey_inbound`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry)** — Short narrative + any flags needed before Titan (or remove hijack from [`post_event`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) if unnecessary). Today it fires **before** Feb crisis and does nothing visible.\n10. **Refugee prelude qualities** — Optionally add 2301 foreshadowing (library / peer media / status) referencing Jovian clan wars and kipple so Feb–Apr events aren't the first mention.\n11. **Election coverage Jan 2300–Jan 2302** — Confirm [`runScheduledElections`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) fires for all district months on calendar; player sees [`scheduled_elections`](source/scenes/events/scheduled_elections.scene.dry) at least twice before 2302.\n\n### Phase D — Refugee crisis **start** (milestone deliverable)\n\n12. **Verify Feb 2302 trigger** — [`refugees_titan`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry): `jovian_refugee_prepare` / `jovian_refugee_dread` stacks already wired in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry); playtest that `third_wave_on_society = 1` unlocks third-wave prosperity row in [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry).\n13. **Minimal follow-through for Mar–Apr** — Expand [`refugees_earth`](source/scenes/major/refugees_earth.scene.dry) and [`refugees_otherworld`](source/scenes/major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry) with at least one meaningful stack or budget/housing pressure each (crisis **continues**, but start is Feb Titan).\n14. **Smoke test full timeline** — Dev cheat or `npm run`-style month advance: 2300-01 → 2302-02 in one session; no JS errors; main deck always has Advance; organizing cards appear after unlock.\n\n### Phase E — Nice-to-have before playtesting wider (non-blocking for “crisis start”)\n\n- Wire [`corp_conflict`](source/scenes/background/corp_conflict.scene.dry) into monthly tick while `cable_break_peace = 0`.\n- Enable `#advisor` deck with Mikasa conditions.\n- Hook [`industries/mining`](source/scenes/industries/mining.scene.dry) into organizing or city deck.\n- Third-wave voter blocks in [`election_runtime`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) if elections should shift after `third_wave_on_society`.\n\n---\n\n## Suggested implementation order\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart TD\n  A[Phase A: loop hygiene] --> B[Phase B: 2300-2301 spine]\n  B --> C[Phase C: 2302 bridge]\n  C --> D[Phase D: refugees_titan milestone]\n  D --> E[Phase E: polish]\n```\n\n**Definition of done for this roadmap:** Player reaches **February 2302**, [`refugees_titan`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry) fires with working choices, `third_wave_on_society` is set, and the monthly loop (organizing cards, elections, cable aftermath, status screen) remains playable.\n\n---\n\n## Related docs\n\n- [`source/election_system.md`](source/election_system.md)\n- [`source/lib/election-v2.md`](source/lib/election-v2.md)\n- [`source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md)\n- [`source/scenes/major/cable_negotiations_thinking.md`](source/scenes/major/cable_negotiations_thinking.md)\n"

## [2026-06-07T14:32:37Z] assistant_thought (afterAgentThought)

A scaling mechanic exists for monthly crime rate changes based on district class percentages.
```json
{
  "duration_ms": 907
}
```

## [2026-06-07T14:32:50Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

**Short answer:** Not for district crime rate itself. There is a close monthly pattern for **prosperity** that uses district stratum population share, but **crime is derived, not ticked**, and the global `crime_level` quality is mostly unused.

## What exists today

### District crime (`pitts_crime`, `docks_crime`, etc.)

These are **not** updated on the monthly tick. They are recomputed when you open a district scene via `Q.syncDistrictDisplays()`:

```1187:1190:source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry
    const gPoll = Number(Q[districtId + '_poll_G']) || 0
    const hPoll = Number(Q[districtId + '_poll_H']) || 0
    const crimeRaw = 12 - Q[key + '_prosperity'] + gPoll * 0.025 + hPoll * 0.012
    Q[key + '_crime'] = Math.round(Math.max(1, Math.min(10, crimeRaw)) * 100) / 100
```

So district crime tracks **population-weighted district prosperity** and **G/H poll share**. It does **not** look at “what % of this district is coop / drone / deeper,” etc.

### Global `Q.crime_level`

This is referenced in `organize_phase_tick.scene.dry` for Pitts prosperity spill and tourism/longshore math, but **nothing in source initializes or changes it monthly**. It’s effectively a stub.

### The closest match: monthly prosperity links, population-weighted by class

The monthly tick (`Q.monthly_tick_phase1` → `applyProsperityConnections()`) **does** apply district-level effects scaled by stratum population. The helper is:

```242:248:source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry
/** 2·sourcePop / (sourcePop + targetPop); IG sources use effective pop below. */
function prosperityTransferMultiplier(sourcePop, targetPop) {
    var a = Number(sourcePop)
    var b = Number(targetPop)
    if (isNaN(a) || isNaN(b) || a <= 0 || b <= 0) { return 0 }
    return (2 * a) / (a + b)
}
```

Used for things like Pitts crime → prosperity (not prosperity → crime):

```497:518:source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry
function applyPittsCrimeProsperityLinks(state, q, blockDeltas) {
    var spec = Q.prosperityPittsCrime || PROSPERITY_PITTS_CRIME
    var excess = economyQualityExcess(q, spec.quality)
    // ...
        var weight = prosperityTransferMultiplier(sourcePop, block.population)
        var transfer = coeff * excess * weight
```

Each **voter block** already has district, stratum (`demographic.id`), and population from `DISTRICT_POPULATIONS` in `election_runtime.scene.dry`, so **class share within a district is available** as `block.population / districtTotalPop`.

The generic `ProsperityConnectionModifier` catalog rows do **not** use that weighting — they apply a flat delta to all matching blocks.

## Bottom line

| Goal | Supported? |
|------|------------|
| Monthly change to **district crime** | **No** — crime is a display formula, not a stored ticked stat |
| Scale effect by **% of district in a stratum** | **Partially** — pattern exists for prosperity via `prosperityTransferMultiplier` + block populations |
| Wire crime ↔ class composition | **Not yet** — would need new tick logic (e.g. extend `syncDistrictDisplays`, add per-district crime qualities, or mirror `applyPittsCrimeProsperityLinks` in reverse) |

If you want this for community outreach or similar, the natural hook is **`monthly_tick_phase1` in `organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`**, reusing `prosperityBlocksInDistrict()` / `prosperityDistrictTotalPop()` and the same population weights — but pointed at crime rather than prosperity.

Dev mirror: `source/lib/election-v2.js`. |\n| Electorate modifier catalog | [`electorate_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry) | `ElectorateModifier` rows; stacks from story choices (`dundalk_*`, contracts, cable neg, refugee prep, …). |\n| Economic assets & housing | [`economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry) | `Q.addAsset` / `Q.addHome`, Jacobs report, monthly housing, budget hooks. |\n| IG leverage / reprisal → attitude labels | [`attitude_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/attitude_runtime.scene.dry) | `Q.syncIgAttitudes()`, used in [`status.scene.dry`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry). |\n| Monthly economy & prosperity mesh | [`organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry) | `Q.monthly_tick_phase1`: trade level, prosperity connections, contracting allowance, cable promise tick, cable syndicate event-ready flags. Catalog doc: [`prosperity_connection_catalog.md`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md). |\n| District map (special UI) | [`district_map_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/district_map_runtime.scene.dry), [`district_map.scene.dry`](source/scenes/district_map.scene.dry) | Map overlay support. |\n| Mod loader hook | [`mod_loader.scene.dry`](source/scenes/mod_loader.scene.dry) | Shell integration. |\n| Corp conflict infra tick (legacy) | [`background/corp_conflict.scene.dry`](source/scenes/background/corp_conflict.scene.dry) | Mutates `district*_infra` from corp relations; **not wired into post_event tick**. |\n| Journey chapter gate (stub) | [`background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry) | Sets `mikasa_journey_leg`; triggered from [`post_event.scene.dry`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) at 2302-01+. |\n| Election scheduling helper | [`set_next_election_time.scene.dry`](source/scenes/set_next_election_time.scene.dry) | Internal / dev. |\n| Q-display labels | [`source/qdisplays/*.qdisplay.dry`](source/qdisplays/) | Month names, prosperity bands, attitudes, parochialism, etc. |\n| Game metadata | [`source/info.dry`](source/info.dry) | Title / author for build. |\n\n**UI / meta (not simulation):** [`status.scene.dry`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry), [`library.scene.dry`](source/scenes/library.scene.dry), [`election_simulation.scene.dry`](source/scenes/election_simulation.scene.dry), [`game_over.scene.dry`](source/scenes/game_over.scene.dry), [`credits.scene.dry`](source/scenes/credits.scene.dry), [`return.scene.dry`](source/scenes/return.scene.dry), [`cancel_advisor_action.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cancel_advisor_action.scene.dry).\n\n**District flavor (read-only):** [`districts/*.scene.dry`](source/scenes/districts/) — Docks, Aurora, Vats, Railyard, Pitts, Limelight, Deeps. Crime/prosperity labels today come from [`election_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) `Q.syncDistrictDisplays()` (prosperity + G/H poll proxy only; **no monthly tick**). See **District crime (planned)** below.\n\n**Advisors (partial):** [`advisors/jacobs.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advisors/jacobs.scene.dry), [`stacy.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advisors/stacy.scene.dry), [`callista.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advisors/callista.scene.dry), [`sage.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advisors/sage.scene.dry) — `#advisor` deck include is **commented out** in [`main.scene.dry`](source/scenes/main.scene.dry).\n\n---\n\n## Cards & events\n\n### Hand / decks ([`main.scene.dry`](source/scenes/main.scene.dry))\n\n| Deck | Tag | Scenes |\n|------|-----|--------|\n| Community Organizing | `#local_organizing` | See table below |\n| City Affairs | `#city_affairs` | **`view-if: phase > 1`** — unlocks after a successful ceasefire deal ([`cable_break_negotiations`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) sets `phase = 2`). |\n| Advance month | pinned card | [`advance.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advance.scene.dry) |\n\n#### `#local_organizing` cards\n\n| Card | Scene | Gating / notes |\n|------|--------|----------------|\n| Activist training | [`activist_training.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/activist_training.scene.dry) | `organizing_unlock`; sabotage/protest truce breaks if cable promises active. |\n| Contracting | [`contracting.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/contracting.scene.dry) | `contracting_visits_remaining`; fair-chain vs patronage; assets + electorate stacks. |\n| Community outreach | [`community_outreach.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/community_outreach.scene.dry) | Community mediation; **should reduce district crime modifier** once crime formula exists (see above). |\n| Co-op economy | [`coop_economy.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/coop_economy.scene.dry) | `organizing_unlock`. |\n| Education | [`education.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/education.scene.dry) | `organizing_unlock`. |\n| Magic | [`magic.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/magic.scene.dry) | `organizing_unlock`. |\n| Migrations | [`migrations.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry) | **`year >= 2302`** — one-shot; Otherworld influx / Uruk migrants (prelude to [`refugees_otherworld`](source/scenes/major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry)). |\n| Peer media | [`peer_media.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/peer_media.scene.dry) | `self_sufficiency_media = 0`. |\n\n#### `#city_affairs` cards\n\n| Card | Scene | Gating / notes |\n|------|--------|----------------|\n| Security / police reform | [`security.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/security.scene.dry) | `police_reform < 4`. |\n| Municipal AI | [`municipal_ai.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/municipal_ai.scene.dry) | No extra gate. |\n| Militia degrade | [`militia_degrade.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/militia_degrade.scene.dry) | `militia >= 1`, no auxiliary. |\n\n**Planned (not implemented):** A City Affairs card to **renegotiate with the megacorps** for control of government functions the ceasefire left split — e.g. civil rights enforcement, judiciary / trials, and other levers first bargained in [`cable_break_negotiations`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry). Replaces the removed Weimar-era **Shuffle Cabinet** stub.\n\n#### Industry scenes (not in main decks)\n\n| Scene | Notes |\n|--------|--------|\n| [`industries/mining.scene.dry`](source/scenes/industries/mining.scene.dry) | Subsidized Pitts mining pitch; `placeholder_metal_demand`. |\n| [`industries/reflector.scene.dry`](source/scenes/industries/reflector.scene.dry) | Bumps metal demand placeholder. |\n\n---\n\n### Scheduled events (`tags: event`)\n\nEvents appear in [`post_event.scene.dry`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) `@events_choice` via `- #event`.\n\n#### Act 1 — 2300 (organizing phase)\n\n| When | Event | Scene |\n|------|--------|--------|\n| One-shot (no date; priority 1) | Political situation / unlock organizing | [`organize_phase_start.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry) — sets `organizing_unlock`, `phase = 1`. |\n| Oct 2300 | September Convention | [`events/september_convention.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/september_convention.scene.dry) |\n\n#### Act 2 — 2301 (corp war & Dundalk)\n\n| When | Event | Scene |\n|------|--------|--------|\n| Jun 2301 | Tether rupture → ceasefire talks | [`major/cable_break.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/cable_break.scene.dry) → [`major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) — successful deal sets `phase = 2` (City Affairs deck). |\n| Jun–2301+ (timed) | Syndicate blind-eye op | [`events/cable_syndicate_blind_eye.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/cable_syndicate_blind_eye.scene.dry) — if blind-eye promise + deal; honor or break choice. |\n| +3 mo after deal | Raid heat (Soylent or Magrail) | [`events/cable_syndicate_raid_soylent.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/cable_syndicate_raid_soylent.scene.dry), [`events/cable_syndicate_raid_magrail.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/cable_syndicate_raid_magrail.scene.dry) |\n| Oct 2301 | Orc marriage 1 | [`events/orc_marriage1.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/orc_marriage1.scene.dry) |\n| Nov 2301 | MSS Dundalk affair | [`events/mss_dundalk_affair.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/mss_dundalk_affair.scene.dry) |\n| Dec 2301 | Orc marriage 2 | [`events/orc_marriage2.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/orc_marriage2.scene.dry) |\n| Every December? | Drone vote buying | [`background/drone_vote_buying.dry`](source/scenes/background/drone_vote_buying.dry) — **`view-if: month = 12` only** (no year / max-visits). |\n\n#### Act 3 — 2302 (**refugee crisis**)\n\n| When | Event | Scene | Status |\n|------|--------|--------|--------|\n| Jan 2302+ | Otherworld migrations (organizing card) | [`cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry) | One-shot; Uruk influx / Kwendi context before Apr surge. |\n| Jan 2302+ | Journey inbound (chapter gate) | [`background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry) | **Stub** — only sets flag. |\n| **Feb 2302** | **Attacks on Titan — crisis starts** | [`major/refugees_titan.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry) | Sets `third_wave_on_society = 1`; prepare vs dread choice. |\n| Mar 2302 | Microkipple / Earth refugees | [`major/refugees_earth.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/refugees_earth.scene.dry) | Minimal (single acknowledgment choice). |\n| Apr 2302 | Otherworld refugee surge | [`major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry) | Minimal flavor choices. |\n| After Apr 2302, `third_wave_on_society` | Abandoned ballroom housing | [`events/municipal/abandoned_ballroom.scene.dry`](source/scenes/municipal/abandoned_ballroom.scene.dry) | **Implemented** — public refugee homes in Docks. |\n| Aug 2302+, `third_wave_on_society` | Aurora pyramid housing | [`events/municipal/aurora_pyramid_housing.scene.dry`](source/scenes/municipal/aurora_pyramid_housing.scene.dry) | **Partial** — defer / ICA paths have TODOs. |\n\n#### Elections\n\n| When | Event | Scene |\n|------|--------|--------|\n| `elections_this_month = 1` | District council elections | [`events/scheduled_elections.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/scheduled_elections.scene.dry) |\n\n#### Post-2302 / disabled / future\n\n| Scene | Status |\n|--------|--------|\n| [`events/otherworld/great_protector.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/otherworld/great_protector.scene.dry) | Aug 2306 |\n| [`events/otherworld/great_protector_dispute.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/otherworld/great_protector_dispute.scene.dry) | Jun 2305 |\n| [`events/rebellion/guild_rebel_electronics.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/rebellion/guild_rebel_electronics.scene.dry) | Partial — guild color gates; supply chain TODO |\n| [`events/rebellion/clans_secret_arms.scene.dry`](source/scenes/rebellion/clans_secret_arms.scene.dry) | **Disabled** (`view-if: … and 0 = 1`) |\n| [`events/rebellion/otherworld_secret_arms.scene.dry`](source/scenes/rebellion/otherworld_secret_arms.scene.dry) | **Disabled** |\n\n---\n\n## Cable ceasefire negotiations (major subsystem)\n\nDesign notes: [`cable_negotiations_thinking.md`](source/scenes/major/cable_negotiations_thinking.md).\n\n**Implemented:** demands (police, tax, trials, disband, prior leverage), promise enticements (sabotage/protest truce, blind eye, raid heat, deeps tax, docks DMZ), leverage/reprisal bargaining, deal win/fail (**win → `phase = 2`**, City Affairs unlock), persisted promises, timed syndicate events, electorate + prosperity hooks, activist truce breaks.\n\n**Still open in source:**\n\n- [`cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) TODO: security-tax → budget revenue; disband → militia/city flags on finalize.\n- `cable_break_peace_frail` set but **no downstream events** read it yet.\n- Activist monthly protest/sabotage vs corp popularity — comment-only TBD in [`organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry).\n\n---\n\n## Achievements\n\n[`game_over.scene.dry`](source/scenes/game_over.scene.dry): **Garden of Olives**, **Cooked Lobster** (+ `game_completed`). Icons in `out/html/img/achievement/`.\n\n---\n\n## Plan: playable path to refugee crisis **start** (Feb 2302)\n\nGoal: a new player can advance from **January 2300 → January 2302**, hit the major story beats, and see **`refugees_titan`** fire as the crisis opener without dead ends or silent broken systems.\n\n### Phase A — Core loop hygiene (blocking)\n\n1. ~~**Advance `phase` beyond 1**~~ — **Done:** [`cable_break_negotiations`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) sets `phase = 2` when ≥2 megacorps accept the ceasefire (Jun 2301). Optionally tie [`organize_phase_tick`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry) trade-level `phase` bands to calendar elsewhere.\n2. ~~**Remove SPD leftovers**~~ — **Done:** deleted [`shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry). **Next:** design a `#city_affairs` card to renegotiate corp control of civil rights, judiciary, and related government levers (see table above).\n3. **Fix [`organize_phase_start`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry) entry** — Either gate it to Jan 2300 month 1 (first `post_event`) or chain explicitly from [`root`](source/scenes/root.scene.dry) `@2300_main_continue` so `organizing_unlock` is guaranteed before October events.\n4. **Date-gate [`drone_vote_buying`](source/scenes/background/drone_vote_buying.dry)** — Add `year`, `max-visits`, or remove until designed; avoid firing every December forever.\n\n### Phase B — 2300–2301 story spine (content)\n\n5. **September Convention fallout** — Ensure [`september_convention`](source/scenes/events/september_convention.scene.dry) stacks (`patriot_meme_strength`, etc.) connect to electorate modifiers already in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry) or add missing rows.\n6. ~~**Migrations card window**~~ — **Done:** [`migrations`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry) now **`year >= 2302`** (was Jan–May 2300); problem/opportunity subscenes still need stack wiring if desired.\n7. **Cable arc polish** — Close negotiation TODOs (tax → budget, disband flags); smoke-test syndicate timed events from a Jun 2301 deal through +1 / +3 months.\n8. **Dundalk + orc events** — [`mss_dundalk_affair`](source/scenes/events/mss_dundalk_affair.scene.dry), [`orc_marriage1/2`](source/scenes/events/orc_marriage1.scene.dry) — verify electorate stacks and martyrs list integrate with [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry) / future content.\n\n### Phase C — Bridge to 2302 (refugee runway)\n\n9. **Implement [`mikasa_journey_inbound`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry)** — Short narrative + any flags needed before Titan (or remove hijack from [`post_event`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) if unnecessary). Today it fires **before** Feb crisis and does nothing visible.\n10. **Refugee prelude qualities** — Optionally add 2301 foreshadowing (library / peer media / status) referencing Jovian clan wars and kipple so Feb–Apr events aren't the first mention.\n11. **Election coverage Jan 2300–Jan 2302** — Confirm [`runScheduledElections`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) fires for all district months on calendar; player sees [`scheduled_elections`](source/scenes/events/scheduled_elections.scene.dry) at least twice before 2302.\n\n### Phase D — Refugee crisis **start** (milestone deliverable)\n\n12. **Verify Feb 2302 trigger** — [`refugees_titan`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry): `jovian_refugee_prepare` / `jovian_refugee_dread` stacks already wired in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry); playtest that `third_wave_on_society = 1` unlocks third-wave prosperity row in [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry).\n13. **Minimal follow-through for Mar–Apr** — Expand [`refugees_earth`](source/scenes/major/refugees_earth.scene.dry) and [`refugees_otherworld`](source/scenes/major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry) with at least one meaningful stack or budget/housing pressure each (crisis **continues**, but start is Feb Titan).\n14. **Smoke test full timeline** — Dev cheat or `npm run`-style month advance: 2300-01 → 2302-02 in one session; no JS errors; main deck always has Advance; organizing cards appear after unlock.\n\n### Phase E — Nice-to-have before playtesting wider (non-blocking for “crisis start”)\n\n- Wire [`corp_conflict`](source/scenes/background/corp_conflict.scene.dry) into monthly tick while `cable_break_peace = 0`.\n- Enable `#advisor` deck with Mikasa conditions.\n- Hook [`industries/mining`](source/scenes/industries/mining.scene.dry) into organizing or city deck.\n- Third-wave voter blocks in [`election_runtime`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) if elections should shift after `third_wave_on_society`.\n\n---\n\n## Suggested implementation order\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart TD\n  A[Phase A: loop hygiene] --> B[Phase B: 2300-2301 spine]\n  B --> C[Phase C: 2302 bridge]\n  C --> D[Phase D: refugees_titan milestone]\n  D --> E[Phase E: polish]\n```\n\n**Definition of done for this roadmap:** Player reaches **February 2302**, [`refugees_titan`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry) fires with working choices, `third_wave_on_society` is set, and the monthly loop (organizing cards, elections, cable aftermath, status screen) remains playable.\n\n---\n\n## Related docs\n\n- [`source/election_system.md`](source/election_system.md)\n- [`source/lib/election-v2.md`](source/lib/election-v2.md)\n- [`source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md)\n- [`source/scenes/major/cable_negotiations_thinking.md`](source/scenes/major/cable_negotiations_thinking.md)\n"
}

The choose-if logic targets the subscene block directly, following the pattern used by the activist scene.

Each community gets a resolved flag. Once resolved, its choice becomes unavailable. On arrival, the flag flips and both cohesion and a placeholder crime-reduction modifier increase. The card hides when all five communities are resolved. Need to check if an organizing unlock is required.

No organizing unlock gate is needed for this card. The placeholder crime-reduction modifier will use a citywide stack so a future formula can read it.

The placeholder crime modifier will be a negative citywide stack value. Outreach success subtracts one from it, lowering overall crime. Each community keeps its own relief value mapped to strata for later expansion.

The placeholder modifier will be a positive relief stack added to the citywide crime modifier. A future tick will subtract it from district crime. The cohesion boost will be a citywide community strength increase.

Lint will run after the edit. Subscene return links were considered but skipped, since the activist scene lacks them and Dendry handles subscene navigation automatically.

Still there are more daring employees who have learned to keep things off the bosses radar.\n\n\n@otherworlders_community\ntitle: Assimilate arrivals from the otherworld\nsubtitle: Ruukish (otherworld humans), Fae, Orcs\nchoose-if: community_otherworld_resolved = 0\nunavailable-subtitle: Otherworlder conflicts already mediated.\non-arrival: community_otherworld_resolved = 1; otherworld_cohesion += 1; crime_relief_otherworld += 1\n\nAlthough small in number, the refugees from the mystic otherworld have extreme culture shock.  What's worse they have brought a bitter ethnic conflict with them, the Orci question.  The orcs are often conflated with the orci, magical immitations of life while the fae are accused of ensnaring others in their magics.  The otherworld humans who typically are at the bottom of the heirarchy in the otherworld resent both groups but have trouble adjusting to a technological existence when they rarely possess basic literacy.\n\nWe can help educate the otherworlders in our ways, hopefullly learning from the times humanity has put aside it's conflicts instead of allowing them to fester.  And in turn we might learn more of the magical arts of the otherworld.  Even if few of the refugees were trained in the magical arts, they have seen far more magic then the vast majority of people from this world.\n"

Prologue text continues at [`root.scene.dry`](source/scenes/root.scene.dry) `@2300_main_continue` → [`organize_phase_start.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry).\n\n---\n\n## Background / runtime mechanics\n\nThese scenes load once (or each boot), define APIs on `Q`, and are not player-facing cards.\n\n| Mechanic | Scene | Notes |\n|--------|--------|--------|\n| Boot orchestration | [`setup_functions.scene.dry`](source/scenes/setup_functions.scene.dry) | Chains runtime scenes until election, electorate, economic, attitude, and organize APIs exist. |\n| Election v2 (tabulation, seats, projections) | [`election_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) | Source of truth for voter blocks, districts, IG boosts. Dev mirror: `source/lib/election-v2.js`. |\n| Electorate modifier catalog | [`electorate_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry) | `ElectorateModifier` rows; stacks from story choices (`dundalk_*`, contracts, cable neg, refugee prep, …). |\n| Economic assets & housing | [`economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry) | `Q.addAsset` / `Q.addHome`, Jacobs report, monthly housing, budget hooks. |\n| IG leverage / reprisal → attitude labels | [`attitude_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/attitude_runtime.scene.dry) | `Q.syncIgAttitudes()`, used in [`status.scene.dry`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry). |\n| Monthly economy & prosperity mesh | [`organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry) | `Q.monthly_tick_phase1`: trade level, prosperity connections, contracting allowance, cable promise tick, cable syndicate event-ready flags. Catalog doc: [`prosperity_connection_catalog.md`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md). |\n| District map (special UI) | [`district_map_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/district_map_runtime.scene.dry), [`district_map.scene.dry`](source/scenes/district_map.scene.dry) | Map overlay support. |\n| Mod loader hook | [`mod_loader.scene.dry`](source/scenes/mod_loader.scene.dry) | Shell integration. |\n| Corp conflict infra tick (legacy) | [`background/corp_conflict.scene.dry`](source/scenes/background/corp_conflict.scene.dry) | Mutates `district*_infra` from corp relations; **not wired into post_event tick**. |\n| Journey chapter gate (stub) | [`background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry) | Sets `mikasa_journey_leg`; triggered from [`post_event.scene.dry`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) at 2302-01+. |\n| Election scheduling helper | [`set_next_election_time.scene.dry`](source/scenes/set_next_election_time.scene.dry) | Internal / dev. |\n| Q-display labels | [`source/qdisplays/*.qdisplay.dry`](source/qdisplays/) | Month names, prosperity bands, attitudes, parochialism, etc. |\n| Game metadata | [`source/info.dry`](source/info.dry) | Title / author for build. |\n\n**UI / meta (not simulation):** [`status.scene.dry`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry), [`library.scene.dry`](source/scenes/library.scene.dry), [`election_simulation.scene.dry`](source/scenes/election_simulation.scene.dry), [`game_over.scene.dry`](source/scenes/game_over.scene.dry), [`credits.scene.dry`](source/scenes/credits.scene.dry), [`return.scene.dry`](source/scenes/return.scene.dry), [`cancel_advisor_action.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cancel_advisor_action.scene.dry).\n\n**District flavor (read-only):** [`districts/*.scene.dry`](source/scenes/districts/) — Docks, Aurora, Vats, Railyard, Pitts, Limelight, Deeps. Crime/prosperity labels today come from [`election_runtime.scene.dry`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) `Q.syncDistrictDisplays()` (prosperity + G/H poll proxy only; **no monthly tick**). See **District crime (planned)** below.\n\n**Advisors (partial):** [`advisors/jacobs.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advisors/jacobs.scene.dry), [`stacy.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advisors/stacy.scene.dry), [`callista.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advisors/callista.scene.dry), [`sage.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advisors/sage.scene.dry) — `#advisor` deck include is **commented out** in [`main.scene.dry`](source/scenes/main.scene.dry).\n\n### District crime (planned)\n\n**Add a crime formula** — replace the display-only stub in `Q.syncDistrictDisplays()` with a **monthly district crime tick** (hook in [`organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry) `monthly_tick_phase1`, or extend election runtime). Per-district stored level (e.g. `Q.pitts_crime` / `<district>_crime`), clamped and labeled via [`crime.qdisplay.dry`](source/qdisplays/crime.qdisplay.dry).\n\n**Base drivers (monthly):**\n\n| Signal | Effect |\n|--------|--------|\n| District prosperity (population-weighted block average) | **Down** — richer, calmer districts |\n| Syndicate **party membership share** in district (G poll / Families–Edges–Sharks footprint by district) | **Up** |\n| Syndicate **prosperity** (`Q.prosperity_families`, `prosperity_edges`, `prosperity_sharks`) | **Up** — strength varies by syndicate × home district (Families → Docks spill, Sharks → Deeps, etc.; mirror [`PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry)) |\n\n**Standard crime modifier** — a single per-district stack (e.g. `<district>_crime_modifier` or one citywide quality applied per district) that other systems add to or subtract from. Cards and police/militia choices bump this stack rather than rewriting crime directly:\n\n- [`security.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/security.scene.dry) (police reform) — negative modifier when reforms land\n- [`militia_degrade.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/militia_degrade.scene.dry) / militia flags — patrol presence reduces modifier (or raises it if unchecked)\n- [`community_outreach.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/community_outreach.scene.dry) — one-shot per community (`community_*_resolved`); citywide `{community}_cohesion` boost + `crime_relief_*` placeholder stacks for future district crime tick.\n\nWire [`districts/*.scene.dry`](source/scenes/districts/) to the ticked values. Retire or repurpose global `Q.crime_level` (currently unread/unset) once per-district crime is authoritative.\n\n---\n\n## Cards & events\n\n### Hand / decks ([`main.scene.dry`](source/scenes/main.scene.dry))\n\n| Deck | Tag | Scenes |\n|------|-----|--------|\n| Community Organizing | `#local_organizing` | See table below |\n| City Affairs | `#city_affairs` | **`view-if: phase > 1`** — unlocks after a successful ceasefire deal ([`cable_break_negotiations`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) sets `phase = 2`). |\n| Advance month | pinned card | [`advance.scene.dry`](source/scenes/advance.scene.dry) |\n\n#### `#local_organizing` cards\n\n| Card | Scene | Gating / notes |\n|------|--------|----------------|\n| Activist training | [`activist_training.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/activist_training.scene.dry) | `organizing_unlock`; sabotage/protest truce breaks if cable promises active. |\n| Contracting | [`contracting.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/contracting.scene.dry) | `contracting_visits_remaining`; fair-chain vs patronage; assets + electorate stacks. |\n| Community outreach | [`community_outreach.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/community_outreach.scene.dry) | One-shot per community; `{community}_cohesion` + `crime_relief_*` placeholders; card hidden when all five resolved. |\n| Co-op economy | [`coop_economy.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/coop_economy.scene.dry) | `organizing_unlock`. |\n| Education | [`education.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/education.scene.dry) | `organizing_unlock`. |\n| Magic | [`magic.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/magic.scene.dry) | `organizing_unlock`. |\n| Migrations | [`migrations.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry) | **`year >= 2302`** — one-shot; Otherworld influx / Uruk migrants (prelude to [`refugees_otherworld`](source/scenes/major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry)). |\n| Peer media | [`peer_media.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/peer_media.scene.dry) | `self_sufficiency_media = 0`. |\n\n#### `#city_affairs` cards\n\n| Card | Scene | Gating / notes |\n|------|--------|----------------|\n| Security / police reform | [`security.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/security.scene.dry) | `police_reform < 4`. |\n| Municipal AI | [`municipal_ai.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/municipal_ai.scene.dry) | No extra gate. |\n| Militia degrade | [`militia_degrade.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/militia_degrade.scene.dry) | `militia >= 1`, no auxiliary. |\n\n**Planned (not implemented):** A City Affairs card to **renegotiate with the megacorps** for control of government functions the ceasefire left split — e.g. civil rights enforcement, judiciary / trials, and other levers first bargained in [`cable_break_negotiations`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry). Replaces the removed Weimar-era **Shuffle Cabinet** stub.\n\n#### Industry scenes (not in main decks)\n\n| Scene | Notes |\n|--------|--------|\n| [`industries/mining.scene.dry`](source/scenes/industries/mining.scene.dry) | Subsidized Pitts mining pitch; `placeholder_metal_demand`. |\n| [`industries/reflector.scene.dry`](source/scenes/industries/reflector.scene.dry) | Bumps metal demand placeholder. |\n\n---\n\n### Scheduled events (`tags: event`)\n\nEvents appear in [`post_event.scene.dry`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) `@events_choice` via `- #event`.\n\n#### Act 1 — 2300 (organizing phase)\n\n| When | Event | Scene |\n|------|--------|--------|\n| One-shot (no date; priority 1) | Political situation / unlock organizing | [`organize_phase_start.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry) — sets `organizing_unlock`, `phase = 1`. |\n| Oct 2300 | September Convention | [`events/september_convention.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/september_convention.scene.dry) |\n\n#### Act 2 — 2301 (corp war & Dundalk)\n\n| When | Event | Scene |\n|------|--------|--------|\n| Jun 2301 | Tether rupture → ceasefire talks | [`major/cable_break.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/cable_break.scene.dry) → [`major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) — successful deal sets `phase = 2` (City Affairs deck). |\n| Jun–2301+ (timed) | Syndicate blind-eye op | [`events/cable_syndicate_blind_eye.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/cable_syndicate_blind_eye.scene.dry) — if blind-eye promise + deal; honor or break choice. |\n| +3 mo after deal | Raid heat (Soylent or Magrail) | [`events/cable_syndicate_raid_soylent.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/cable_syndicate_raid_soylent.scene.dry), [`events/cable_syndicate_raid_magrail.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/cable_syndicate_raid_magrail.scene.dry) |\n| Oct 2301 | Orc marriage 1 | [`events/orc_marriage1.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/orc_marriage1.scene.dry) |\n| Nov 2301 | MSS Dundalk affair | [`events/mss_dundalk_affair.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/mss_dundalk_affair.scene.dry) |\n| Dec 2301 | Orc marriage 2 | [`events/orc_marriage2.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/orc_marriage2.scene.dry) |\n| Every December? | Drone vote buying | [`background/drone_vote_buying.dry`](source/scenes/background/drone_vote_buying.dry) — **`view-if: month = 12` only** (no year / max-visits). |\n\n#### Act 3 — 2302 (**refugee crisis**)\n\n| When | Event | Scene | Status |\n|------|--------|--------|--------|\n| Jan 2302+ | Otherworld migrations (organizing card) | [`cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry) | One-shot; Uruk influx / Kwendi context before Apr surge. |\n| Jan 2302+ | Journey inbound (chapter gate) | [`background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry) | **Stub** — only sets flag. |\n| **Feb 2302** | **Attacks on Titan — crisis starts** | [`major/refugees_titan.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry) | Sets `third_wave_on_society = 1`; prepare vs dread choice. |\n| Mar 2302 | Microkipple / Earth refugees | [`major/refugees_earth.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/refugees_earth.scene.dry) | Minimal (single acknowledgment choice). |\n| Apr 2302 | Otherworld refugee surge | [`major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry) | Minimal flavor choices. |\n| After Apr 2302, `third_wave_on_society` | Abandoned ballroom housing | [`events/municipal/abandoned_ballroom.scene.dry`](source/scenes/municipal/abandoned_ballroom.scene.dry) | **Implemented** — public refugee homes in Docks. |\n| Aug 2302+, `third_wave_on_society` | Aurora pyramid housing | [`events/municipal/aurora_pyramid_housing.scene.dry`](source/scenes/municipal/aurora_pyramid_housing.scene.dry) | **Partial** — defer / ICA paths have TODOs. |\n\n#### Elections\n\n| When | Event | Scene |\n|------|--------|--------|\n| `elections_this_month = 1` | District council elections | [`events/scheduled_elections.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/scheduled_elections.scene.dry) |\n\n#### Post-2302 / disabled / future\n\n| Scene | Status |\n|--------|--------|\n| [`events/otherworld/great_protector.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/otherworld/great_protector.scene.dry) | Aug 2306 |\n| [`events/otherworld/great_protector_dispute.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/otherworld/great_protector_dispute.scene.dry) | Jun 2305 |\n| [`events/rebellion/guild_rebel_electronics.scene.dry`](source/scenes/events/rebellion/guild_rebel_electronics.scene.dry) | Partial — guild color gates; supply chain TODO |\n| [`events/rebellion/clans_secret_arms.scene.dry`](source/scenes/rebellion/clans_secret_arms.scene.dry) | **Disabled** (`view-if: … and 0 = 1`) |\n| [`events/rebellion/otherworld_secret_arms.scene.dry`](source/scenes/rebellion/otherworld_secret_arms.scene.dry) | **Disabled** |\n\n---\n\n## Cable ceasefire negotiations (major subsystem)\n\nDesign notes: [`cable_negotiations_thinking.md`](source/scenes/major/cable_negotiations_thinking.md).\n\n**Implemented:** demands (police, tax, trials, disband, prior leverage), promise enticements (sabotage/protest truce, blind eye, raid heat, deeps tax, docks DMZ), leverage/reprisal bargaining, deal win/fail (**win → `phase = 2`**, City Affairs unlock), persisted promises, timed syndicate events, electorate + prosperity hooks, activist truce breaks.\n\n**Still open in source:**\n\n- [`cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) TODO: security-tax → budget revenue; disband → militia/city flags on finalize.\n- `cable_break_peace_frail` set but **no downstream events** read it yet.\n- Activist monthly protest/sabotage vs corp popularity — comment-only TBD in [`organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry).\n\n---\n\n## Achievements\n\n[`game_over.scene.dry`](source/scenes/game_over.scene.dry): **Garden of Olives**, **Cooked Lobster** (+ `game_completed`). Icons in `out/html/img/achievement/`.\n\n---\n\n## Plan: playable path to refugee crisis **start** (Feb 2302)\n\nGoal: a new player can advance from **January 2300 → January 2302**, hit the major story beats, and see **`refugees_titan`** fire as the crisis opener without dead ends or silent broken systems.\n\n### Phase A — Core loop hygiene (blocking)\n\n1. ~~**Advance `phase` beyond 1**~~ — **Done:** [`cable_break_negotiations`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) sets `phase = 2` when ≥2 megacorps accept the ceasefire (Jun 2301). Optionally tie [`organize_phase_tick`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry) trade-level `phase` bands to calendar elsewhere.\n2. ~~**Remove SPD leftovers**~~ — **Done:** deleted [`shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry). **Next:** design a `#city_affairs` card to renegotiate corp control of civil rights, judiciary, and related government levers (see table above).\n3. **Fix [`organize_phase_start`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry) entry** — Either gate it to Jan 2300 month 1 (first `post_event`) or chain explicitly from [`root`](source/scenes/root.scene.dry) `@2300_main_continue` so `organizing_unlock` is guaranteed before October events.\n4. **Date-gate [`drone_vote_buying`](source/scenes/background/drone_vote_buying.dry)** — Add `year`, `max-visits`, or remove until designed; avoid firing every December forever.\n\n### Phase B — 2300–2301 story spine (content)\n\n5. **September Convention fallout** — Ensure [`september_convention`](source/scenes/events/september_convention.scene.dry) stacks (`patriot_meme_strength`, etc.) connect to electorate modifiers already in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry) or add missing rows.\n6. ~~**Migrations card window**~~ — **Done:** [`migrations`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry) now **`year >= 2302`** (was Jan–May 2300); problem/opportunity subscenes still need stack wiring if desired.\n7. **Cable arc polish** — Close negotiation TODOs (tax → budget, disband flags); smoke-test syndicate timed events from a Jun 2301 deal through +1 / +3 months.\n8. **Dundalk + orc events** — [`mss_dundalk_affair`](source/scenes/events/mss_dundalk_affair.scene.dry), [`orc_marriage1/2`](source/scenes/events/orc_marriage1.scene.dry) — verify electorate stacks and martyrs list integrate with [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry) / future content.\n\n### Phase C — Bridge to 2302 (refugee runway)\n\n9. **Implement [`mikasa_journey_inbound`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry)** — Short narrative + any flags needed before Titan (or remove hijack from [`post_event`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) if unnecessary). Today it fires **before** Feb crisis and does nothing visible.\n10. **Refugee prelude qualities** — Optionally add 2301 foreshadowing (library / peer media / status) referencing Jovian clan wars and kipple so Feb–Apr events aren't the first mention.\n11. **Election coverage Jan 2300–Jan 2302** — Confirm [`runScheduledElections`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) fires for all district months on calendar; player sees [`scheduled_elections`](source/scenes/events/scheduled_elections.scene.dry) at least twice before 2302.\n\n### Phase D — Refugee crisis **start** (milestone deliverable)\n\n12. **Verify Feb 2302 trigger** — [`refugees_titan`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry): `jovian_refugee_prepare` / `jovian_refugee_dread` stacks already wired in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry); playtest that `third_wave_on_society = 1` unlocks third-wave prosperity row in [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry).\n13. **Minimal follow-through for Mar–Apr** — Expand [`refugees_earth`](source/scenes/major/refugees_earth.scene.dry) and [`refugees_otherworld`](source/scenes/major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry) with at least one meaningful stack or budget/housing pressure each (crisis **continues**, but start is Feb Titan).\n14. **Smoke test full timeline** — Dev cheat or `npm run`-style month advance: 2300-01 → 2302-02 in one session; no JS errors; main deck always has Advance; organizing cards appear after unlock.\n\n### Phase E — Nice-to-have before playtesting wider (non-blocking for “crisis start”)\n\n- **Add district crime formula** — monthly tick + standard crime modifier stack; prosperity down, syndicate membership/prosperity up (syndicate × district); hook police ([`security`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/security.scene.dry)), militia, and [`community_outreach`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/community_outreach.scene.dry).\n- Wire [`corp_conflict`](source/scenes/background/corp_conflict.scene.dry) into monthly tick while `cable_break_peace = 0`.\n- Enable `#advisor` deck with Mikasa conditions.\n- Hook [`industries/mining`](source/scenes/industries/mining.scene.dry) into organizing or city deck.\n- Third-wave voter blocks in [`election_runtime`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) if elections should shift after `third_wave_on_society`.\n\n---\n\n## Suggested implementation order\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart TD\n  A[Phase A: loop hygiene] --> B[Phase B: 2300-2301 spine]\n  B --> C[Phase C: 2302 bridge]\n  C --> D[Phase D: refugees_titan milestone]\n  D --> E[Phase E: polish]\n```\n\n**Definition of done for this roadmap:** Player reaches **February 2302**, [`refugees_titan`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry) fires with working choices, `third_wave_on_society` is set, and the monthly loop (organizing cards, elections, cable aftermath, status screen) remains playable.\n\n---\n\n## Related docs\n\n- [`source/election_system.md`](source/election_system.md)\n- [`source/lib/election-v2.md`](source/lib/election-v2.md)\n- [`source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md)\n- [`source/scenes/major/cable_negotiations_thinking.md`](source/scenes/major/cable_negotiations_thinking.md)\n"
}

## [2026-06-07T14:41:39Z] assistant (afterAgentResponse)

Updated `community_outreach.scene.dry`:

**One-shot per community** — Each subscene sets `community_*_resolved = 1` and uses `choose-if` / `unavailable-subtitle` so it can only be picked once.

**New effects (replacing dissent/prosperity tweaks):**

| Community | Cohesion boost | Crime placeholder |
|-----------|----------------|-------------------|
| First wave | `first_wave_cohesion += 1` | `crime_relief_first_wave += 1` |
| Second wave | `second_wave_cohesion += 1` | `crime_relief_second_wave += 1` |
| Isolated | `isolated_cohesion += 1` | `crime_relief_isolated += 1` |
| Drones | `drones_cohesion += 1` | `crime_relief_drones += 1` |
| Otherworlders | `otherworld_cohesion += 1` | `crime_relief_otherworld += 1` |

**Card hidden when done** — `view-if` requires at least one `community_*_resolved = 0`; once all five are resolved, the card leaves the deck.

The `crime_relief_*` stacks are placeholders for the planned district crime tick. Roadmap notes were updated to match. Lint passes.
